bbctwo.uk.title: Homes Under the Hammer
bbctwo.uk.description: Two ceilings on the brink of collapse in flats in Scotland and London cause issues for the new owners, and Dion is impressed by the motivations of a pair of purchasers in Merseyside.

bbctwowales.uk.title: Bargain Hunt
bbctwowales.uk.description: The teams shop for antiques at Southwell Racecourse, but will their items be going, going, gone at Hettie Jago's auction in Nottingham? [S,AD]

bbctwowales.uk.title: Antiques Road Trip
bbctwowales.uk.description: 15/20. Margie and Ishy buckle up for one last spin through the Home Counties. In Luton, they swap antiques for elaborate costumes and dancing. But who will step up at the final auction? [S,AD]

bbctwowales.uk.title: Best of Weatherman Walking
bbctwowales.uk.description: 3/10. Derek visits the Lourdes of Wales, sees how walking aids a cancer patient's recuperation and helps a woman with sight loss enjoy birdwatching. [S,SL]

bbctwowales.uk.title: Best of Weatherman Walking
bbctwowales.uk.description: 4/10. Mynydd Sygun in Eryri National Park, the Black Mountains in the east of Bannau Brycheiniog and Table Mountain in Powys all feature among Derek's favourite mountain walks. [S,SL]

bbctwowales.uk.title: BBC News
bbctwowales.uk.description: Twenty-four hours a day, the latest national and international stories as they break.

bbctwowales.uk.title: Politics Live
bbctwowales.uk.description: The big political issues of the day.

bbctwowales.uk.title: Impossible
bbctwowales.uk.description: 1/20. Game show presented by Rick Edwards in which players score points by answering questions correctly while avoiding the Impossible answers.

bbctwowales.uk.title: Unbeatable
bbctwowales.uk.description: 36/45. Jason Manford hosts the quiz show where players face a question and pick from a board of six rankable answers. Some answers are good, but only one is Unbeatable.

bbctwowales.uk.title: The Boss
bbctwowales.uk.description: 5/20. Susan Calman hosts the quiz show of tactics, knowledge and nerve. Contestants must work as a team, but ultimately there can only be one Boss. Who will walk away with the money?

bbctwowales.uk.title: Beechgrove Repotted
bbctwowales.uk.description: George builds mini cold frames out of recycled materials to see just how productive you can be in a small space.

bbctwowales.uk.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
bbctwowales.uk.description: 8/10. The quarter-finalists go back to the 1930s to make women's sailor trousers. They also turn men's shirts into 1930s blouses and fit glamorous bias-cut evening gowns. [S,AD]

bbctwowales.uk.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow
bbctwowales.uk.description: 22/26. Michael Aspel invites members of the public to offer up their antiques for expert examination. In Wigan, finds include a cache of silver buried in World War II.

bbctwowales.uk.title: Flog It!
bbctwowales.uk.description: 45/60. Antiques series. Paul Martin is joined by Caroline Hawley and Adam Partridge at historic Haddon Hall in Derbyshire, where finds include a stylish RAF drinks dispenser.

bbctwowales.uk.title: New: House of Games
bbctwowales.uk.description: 6/95. Stephen Mangan, Shona McGarty, Andi Peters and Nina Wadia test their general knowledge skills on this week's House of Games as Michael Sheen takes the helm.

bbctwowales.uk.title: Strictly - It Takes Two
bbctwowales.uk.description: 6/60. Ellie Taylor kicks off the week with a chat with the first couple to be eliminated.

bbctwowales.uk.title: Scrum V Highlights
bbctwowales.uk.description: Highlights of the weekend's action in the United Rugby Championship.

bbctwowales.uk.title: Mastermind
bbctwowales.uk.description: 11/31. Four more contenders brave the black chair in another heat of the classic quiz. The specialist subjects are the Aztec Empire, Janis Joplin, Agatha Christie's Poirot and Max Verstappen.

bbctwowales.uk.title: Only Connect
bbctwowales.uk.description: 13/34. Victoria Coren Mitchell hosts the quiz where knowledge only gets you so far. Neither team is eliminated this time, and there's some quality quizzing on display.

bbctwowales.uk.title: University Challenge
bbctwowales.uk.description: 13/37. The University of Glasgow takes on Goldsmiths, University of London in the penultimate match of the first round. Amol Rajan asks the questions.

bbctwowales.uk.title: Damilola: The Untold Story
bbctwowales.uk.description: A look at the murder of Damilola Taylor, shedding fresh light with new testimony. Contains scenes which some viewers may find upsetting. [S,AD]

bbctwowales.uk.title: It Happened to Me: I Lived Another Life in a Coma
bbctwowales.uk.description: A peak athlete's organs failed. Then the dreams from his coma started becoming reality.

bbctwowales.uk.title: Newsnight, followed by Weather
bbctwowales.uk.description: Insights and global interviews on the news stories of the day. With Victoria Derbyshire.   Followed by Weather.

bbctwowales.uk.title: Till
bbctwowales.uk.description: A 14-year-old boy's 1955 Mississippi lynching spurs his mother to anti-racist activism. Contains some scenes which some viewers may find upsetting. [2022]

bbctwowales.uk.title: Lifeline
bbctwowales.uk.description: Seema Jaswal presents an appeal on behalf of Meningitis Now, a charity which provides emotional, practical and financial support to people and families affected by meningitis. [S,AD,SL]

bbctwowales.uk.title: Countryfile
bbctwowales.uk.description: To mark World Rivers Day, Matt Baker and Margherita Taylor explore the River Trent and the land that surrounds it. [S,SL]

bbctwowales.uk.title: The Celebrity Traitors
bbctwowales.uk.description: 1/10. Claudia Winkleman welcomes a brand new group of celebrities to the Scottish Highlands. [S,AD,SL]

bbctwowales.uk.title: The Celebrity Traitors: Uncloaked
bbctwowales.uk.description: 1/10. Ed Gamble and guests unpack all the drama from episode 1 of the second series of The Celebrity Traitors. [S,AD,SL]

stvnorth.uk.title: The Chase
stvnorth.uk.description: S17 E48 Bradley Walsh hosts as Stephen from the Wirral, Rosemary from Buckingham, Georgie from Westgate-on-Sea and Fionn from Nottingham hope that they can take a cash prize home together.

stvnorth.uk.title: ITV Evening News; Weather
stvnorth.uk.description: S11 E198 05/10/2026 A round-up of the day's news headlines and talking points from the UK and around the world.

stvnorth.uk.title: Cooking with the Stars
stvnorth.uk.description: S6 E1 Family Favourites Emma Willis and Tom Allen return with the contest as 12 famous faces are each mentored by a chef to compete in culinary battles over 10 weeks. The first head-to-head showdown is between actress Caroline Quentin, Gladiators star Harry Aikines-Aryeetey and Emmerdale actor Mark Charnock as they attempt to deliver classic family favourites. One contestant will go straight through to the next round, while the other two face each other in the dreaded cook off, after which one of them will leave the competition.

stvnorth.uk.title: Emmerdale
stvnorth.uk.description: E10670 05/10/2026 Thea is in need of a plan, while Manpreet puts Gabby first, and Sadie is alarmed to know there are voicemails at large.

stvnorth.uk.title: Coronation Street
stvnorth.uk.description: E11955 05/10/2026 Doug is assessed by a mental health team after Jodie brands him dangerous, but he warns Shona not to trust her, and Bethany catches Jodie red-handed. Elsewhere, Sally orders Christina to avoid vulnerable Lucy, while Summer learns Marco was the getaway driver in a car crash and faces a difficult decision.

stvnorth.uk.title: The Blame
stvnorth.uk.description: S1 E6 Things come to a head when the identity of the serial abuser is finally revealed, but Emma uncovers a further clue, forcing a devastating confrontation. Crime drama, starring Michelle Keegan and Douglas Booth.

stvnorth.uk.title: ITV News at Ten; Weather
stvnorth.uk.description: S11 E198 05/10/2026 A fresh perspective on the major stories of the day, featuring national and international news, with reports and analysis from ITV's correspondents.

stvnorth.uk.title: Peston

stvnorth.uk.title: The Assembly
stvnorth.uk.description: S2 E2 Nicola Sturgeon Nicola Sturgeon has the grilling of a lifetime from neurodivergent interviewers. Why did she separate from her husband? Who does she most loathe in politics? Nothing is off limits.

stvnorth.uk.title: Wheel of Fortune
stvnorth.uk.description: S2 E3 Graham Norton hosts the game show, which sees novelty shop owner Jess, learning and development trainer Xhemal and former GP Pip spin the wheel and try to solve the word puzzles in a bid to win big money prizes, with a potential jackpot of £50,000.

stvnorth.uk.description: S2026 06/10/2026 Morning magazine featuring a lively mix of news and current affairs, plus health, entertainment and lifestyle features.

Will any of the friends survive the nightmarish ordeal? (Horror) - 2003

Along the way, bikers harass the foursome and cause an accident that throws Chrissie from the vehicle. The lawman who arrives on the scene kills one of the bikers and brings Chrissie's friends to the Hewitt homestead, where young Leatherface is learning the tools of terror. (Horror) - 2006

amc.us.title: From Dusk Till Dawn
amc.us.description: On the run from a bank robbery that left several police officers dead, Seth Gecko (George Clooney) and his paranoid, loose-cannon brother, Richard (Quentin Tarantino), hightail it to the Mexican border. Kidnapping preacher Jacob Fuller (Harvey Keitel) and his kids, the criminals sneak across the border in the family's RV and hole up in a topless bar. Unfortunately, the bar also happens to be home base for a gang of vampires, and the brothers and their hostages have to fight their way out. (Horror, Action, Dark comedy, Thriller, Crime drama) - 1996

amc.us.title: House of Wax
amc.us.description: A gang of college friends, including Wade (Jared Padalecki) and his girlfriend, Carly (Elisha Cuthbert), are en route to a school football game when they wind up with a flat tire in a ghost town. They are forced to seek help in the only place that's open: the local wax museum. Once inside the spooky and seemingly abandoned building, they find the works on display are not quite what they seem -- and the group soon discovers it's being hunted by the insane twin brothers who run the museum. (Horror) - 2005

amc.us.title: I Know What You Did Last Summer
amc.us.description: A year after running over a fisherman and dumping his body in the water, four friends reconvene when Julie (Jennifer Love Hewitt) receives a frightening letter telling her that their crime was seen. While pursuing who he thinks is responsible for the letter, Barry (Ryan Phillippe) is run over by a man with a meat hook. The bloodletting only increases from there, as the killer with the hook continues to stalk Julie, Helen (Sarah Michelle Gellar) and Ray (Freddie Prinze Jr.). (Horror, Thriller) - 1997

amc.us.title: Final Destination
amc.us.description: Alex Browning is embarking on a trip to Paris. He experiences a premonition -- he sees the plane explode moments after leaving the ground. Insisting that everyone get off the plane, Alex and seven other people are forced to disembark. All watch as the plane actually explodes in a fireball. He and the other survivors have briefly cheated death, but will not be able to evade their fate for very long. One by one, these fugitives from fate fall victim to the grim reaper. (Horror, Thriller) - 2000

amc.us.title: Final Destination 2
amc.us.description: Kimberly (A.J. Cook) has a premonition of a horrible highway accident killing multiple people -- including her and her friends. She blocks the cars behind her on the ramp from joining traffic -- and as a police trooper (Michael Landes) arrives, the accident actually happens. Now, Death is stalking this group of mistaken survivors -- and one by one they are dying as they were supposed to on the highway. (Horror, Thriller) - 2003

amc.us.title: The Final Destination
amc.us.description: While enjoying a day at the track, Nick O'Bannon (Bobby Campo) has a horrific premonition of his friends and him all dying in a freak accident involving many racecars. Mere seconds before the vision comes true, he manages to convince them to leave. Although they cheat death then, the survivors each begin to meet a grisly end, and Nick tries to figure a way to escape a similar fate. (Horror, Thriller) - 2009

amc.us.title: The Last House on the Left
amc.us.description: Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. Mari makes her way back home, where her parents, John (Tony Goldwyn) and Emma (Monica Potter), have unwittingly offered shelter to the thugs. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari. (Horror, Thriller) - 2009

secnetwork.us.title: The Paul Finebaum Show ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
secnetwork.us.description: Veteran writer, reporter and radio personality Paul Finebaum built a legion of loyal sports fans as the "Voice of the SEC" during 20 years hosting his Birmingham, Ala.-based radio talk show. When ESPN launched the SEC Network in 2014, it was only natural that Finebaum became its first on-air hire, bringing his radio show -- and those passionate followers -- with him. Now originating from one of the SEC Network studios in Charlotte, N.C., the show is a forum for lively discussion and debate of all things SEC and across the spectrum of college sports, with Finebaum playing the role of both moderator and provocateur. The show airs weekday afternoons throughout the year on SEC Network. (Sports talk, Interview) - 2013-12-02

673498.title: 3:10 to Yuma
673498.description: Dan Evans (Van Heflin), a drought-plagued Arizona rancher, volunteers to take captured stagecoach robber and murderer Ben Wade (Glenn Ford) from Bisbee to Contention City, where the criminal will be put aboard the 3:10 train to Yuma for his trial. Accompanied only by the town drunk, Alex Potter (Henry Jones), Dan battles Wade's henchman (Richard Jaeckel), the murder victim's revenge-minded brother, and the temptation of the large bribe Wade offers in exchange for his freedom.

673498.title: The Big Gundown
673498.description: Lawman John Corbett (Lee Van Cleef) searches the U.S.-Mexico border for a Mexican peasant (Tomas Milian) accused of raping and killing a 12-year-old girl.

673498.title: Headin' East
673498.description: A cowboy discards his chaps and saddle for a suit and tie when he travels to the big city to investigate a produce racket that has been ruining his father's lettuce shipments.

673498.title: The Law vs. Billy the Kid
673498.description: The notorious gunslinger’s new courtship with a rancher's lovely daughter is cut prematurely short when the law unexpectedly catches up with him.

673498.title: The California Trail
673498.description: Cowboy Santa Fe Stewart (Buck Jones) fights a tyrant in Spanish California.

673498.title: Count Three and Pray
673498.description: After fighting for the Union during the Civil War, Luke Fargo (Van Heflin) is greeted with resentment when he returns home to his small southern town. Luke has a reputation as a rogue, but he's reinvented himself as a man of God and plans to fix up the town's damaged church. Recalling their romantic past, Georgina Decrais (Allison Hayes) tries to reclaim Luke. But, to the dismay of some suspicious townspeople, he concentrates on mentoring an unsophisticated young woman, Lissy (Joanne Woodward).

673498.title: Jack McCall, Desperado
673498.description: A lone gunslinger, Jack McCall (George Montgomery), bursts into a saloon and shoots dead the legendary Wild Bill Hickok (Douglas Kennedy). Arrested and put on trial, McCall recounts a twisted tale that paints Hickok as anything but heroic, explaining how Hickok and McCall's cousin Bat (James Seay) took over McCall's family's plantation, killed his parents and even framed him for crimes he didn't commit. McCall's cold-blooded killing of Hickok was warranted. Or was it?

673498.title: A Lawless Street
673498.description: The honorable Calem Ware (Randolph Scott), marshal of the Wild West boomtown of Medicine Bend, attempts to defuse the simmering tensions in his rapidly growing and increasingly violent town, as a greedy businessman (Warner Anderson) hires a sinister black-gloved gunman (Michael Pate) to take care of his problems with the marshal for good. Meanwhile, a traveling song-and-dance troupe arrives in town, bearing Ware's lost love, Tally (Angela Lansbury), who holds the secret to his violent past.

673498.title: Comanche Station
673498.description: When solitary cowboy Jefferson Cody (Randolph Scott) hears tales of a white woman living as a captive of the Comanche tribe, he rides deep into the tribe's territory to exchange goods for her freedom. As Cody escorts the captive woman away, he learns that she is Nancy Lowe (Nancy Gates), and that there is a sizable reward offered by her husband for her return. Cody and Mrs. Lowe must brave ruthless bounty hunters greedy for the reward, as well as the now-warring Comanches, to make it to safety.

673498.title: Al Jennings of Oklahoma
673498.description: Lawyer Al (Dan Duryea) and brother Frank (Dick Foran) turn to robbing banks and trains after Union troops raid their home.

673498.title: Legend of the Golden Gun
673498.description: After his family is killed, a quiet, young farmer turns into a deadly gunfighter, dedicating his life to the pursuit of evildoers.

673498.title: The New Daughters of Joshua Cabe
673498.description: While posing as his daughters, three women discover an elderly homesteader has been falsely imprisoned for murder and hatch a plot to smuggle him out.

673500.title: We Were Strangers
673500.description: When her brother is murdered, China Valdez (Jennifer Jones) swears revenge on the corrupt Cuban government he had been protesting. She joins the resistance led by Tony (John Garfield), an American with a plan that promises devastating results to their enemies. First they'll kill a government official, then plant a bomb at the funeral, which will wipe out the dead man's associates when it explodes. All they need to do is to dig an underground tunnel from China's house to the cemetery next door.

673500.title: The Taming of the Shrew
673500.description: A rich merchant's beautiful daughter and her volatile older sister are courted by rival suitors in this rambunctious version of Shakespeare's comedy.

673500.title: Only Angels Have Wings
673500.description: Rough and tough Geoff Carter (Cary Grant) runs a tiny airline that cannot afford to miss any flights, despite the dangers along many of the routes. When Bonnie Lee (Jean Arthur), a performer who is falling for him, sees that Geoff is preparing to fly in violent weather conditions, she takes measures to make him stay. She's successful in her attempt, and two of his employees are forced to make the flight for him -- but Bonnie may have been correct about the potential peril of that flight.

673500.title: The Harder They Fall
673500.description: Broke and without work, newspaper reporter Eddie Willis (Humphrey Bogart) agrees to work for the corrupt boxing promoter Nick Benko (Rod Steiger) to help hype his new boxer, Toro Moreno (Mike Lane). While Toro is beastly in appearance, he has no actual boxing talent, and all his fights are fixed. When Toro gets a shot at the title against the brutal Buddy Brannen (Max Baer), Willis is faced with the tough decision of whether or not to tell Toro that his entire career is a sham.

673500.title: The Black Knight
673500.description: Spurred by love for the beautiful Lady Linet (Patricia Medina), humble sword-maker John (Alan Ladd) begins training to become a knight. When a raid on the castle leads to the death of Linet's mother and the incapacitation of her father, the earl of Yeonil (Harry Andrews), John's chase after the evildoers is misunderstood as cowardly running away. Transforming himself into the mysterious Black Knight, John infiltrates the castle of King Arthur (Anthony Bushell) to unmask the ne'er-do-wells.

673500.title: The Long Gray Line
673500.description: An Irish immigrant who found a home in the Army as a West Point instructor becomes very close to his pupils, one of whom is Dwight Eisenhower.

673500.title: Gidget
673500.description: A self-conscious teen gains confidence when two surfers show interest, challenging her insecurities and changing how she sees herself.

673500.title: 5 Against the House
673500.description: At Harold's Club in Reno, what begins as a joke for four college friends ends as a reality, when a heist goes ahead with disastrous results.

692051.description: Eight years ago, the whole crew of a scare house were killed on its opening night. Now, a journalist and her crew will break in to find out the truth.

692051.description: A mental patient tells his psychiatrist how he became a killer, after his brother died during their childhood, because of a certain Mother Superior.

692051.description: Murphy's dad comes to town, bringing up old resentments, and when he starts interfering with her case of reformed criminals dying mysteriously, and Harry's participation in it, things go from bad to worse.

692051.description: Dresden takes on the case of a boy who's sure monsters are stalking him, but a misstep by Harry puts everyone at risk.

692051.description: A police lieutenant seeks answers in a psychiatric ward, when he ties a string of current murders to those of a serial killer executed long ago.

692051.description: A bloodthirsty grizzly bear stalks two estranged brothers (James Marsden, Thomas Jane) in the Alaskan wilderness.

692051.description: An experimental surgery leaves an injured motorcyclist with a thirst for human blood, spreading a disease that turns people into ravenous monsters.

692051.description: A violent young woman and felon gets placed on house arrest, but prison would be safer for her than what becomes a halfway house of paranormal horror.

692087.description: A new pastor tries to leave a positive legacy on his church, but his troubled past resurfaces. Will he find the strength to overcome his mistakes?

692087.description: On a hot summer day, BJ battles a bitter baby mama and a crooked cop to resume his brother’s legacy of hosting the baddest block party in New Orleans.

692087.description: As their conflicting ideas begin to take a toll on their relationship, an investigator plans to prove his lover, an assistant DA, wrong about a case.

692087.description: Jillian returns to Watts after a troubled military discharge. Finding her family in hardship, she plans a risky heist, but survival has a deadly cost.

692087.description: The fierce head of an all-female former gang that broke up gets them in the saddle again to hunt down treasure and avenge her sister’s death.

692087.description: A story of pursuing integrity amid adversity, this film centers around a couple's challenging journey as they bootstrap an indie recording company.

692087.title: Measure of Faith
692087.description: A family’s faith is tested after the death of their grandmother and matriarch reveals secrets and betrayals.

692087.title: Dangerous Seduction
692087.description: A business trip in Florida for a top sports reporter turns into love triangle trouble with his ex after a one-night-stand with his host’s daughter.

692087.title: The Great Divide
692087.description: Crossing the bridge of love isn't easy for a group of couples in this comedy about hidden secrets, flaring tempers, spicy passions and new life.

700407.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don travels from the north west coast of Scotland to the north east coast of England, from historic reconstructions to modern re-inventions. He visits some of the most inhospitable places in the country and finds gardens that are flourishing.

700407.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
700407.description: Monty travels across some of the country's landscapes, heading across the north of England to Northern Ireland. Here, Monty sees the ingenuity, passion and determination of British people to garden and create gardens, no matter what the canvas.

700407.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
700407.description: Monty travels across the middle of the country, from Wales to Norfolk. He comes across gardens for gnomes, much-loved, well-tended allotments and extravagant gardens that bankrupted their owners.

700407.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don explores the most densely populated part of the country, London and the home counties. He visits some of London's gardens, including a special one on a barge, as well as a beautifully restored garden close to where he grew up in Hampshire.

700407.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
700407.description: Monty travels across the south west of the country to visit some of Britain's most exotic gardens. On this journey, Monty also goes to some of the country's most historic gardens, as well as some challenging contemporary ones.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: In the cottage garden, Monty is moving a rose which has outgrown its space and in the vegetable garden he gives advice on what to plant now for spring. He also finds out more about the mysterious world of earthworms and discovers why they are vital for the garden.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: As Monty brings in the summer harvest, he gives advice on what to sow to keep the crops coming up to the end of Autumn. Carol Klein visits a woman who is losing her eyesight and gives her recommendations of plants that will be a feast for her senses.

700407.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don conducts a personal grand tour around Italy's magnificent gardens from the luxurious retreats of the moneyed north to the lavish hideaways of the romantic south. In this episode, he's in and around Rome, a powerbase of emperors and popes, to explore gardens that are among some of the most extravagant and flamboyant ever created in history.

700407.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don is on a grand tour around Italy, this time visiting gardens both in Florence and around the sun-scorched Tuscan countryside. Monty discovers how, like a piece of sculpture, renaissance gardens were created as works of art, and how a group of Edwardian ex-pats mistakenly reinforced the idea that formal Italian gardens were flowerless.

700407.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don continues his grand garden tour of Italy. This time he is in Naples to visit some of the most sublime, romantic retreats in southern Italy. After all the formality of the green gardens around Rome and Florence, Monty seeks out idyllic horticultural gems set against the dramatic scenery of the Amalfi Coast to discover why, in the south, gardens are informal and, above all, filled with flowers.

700407.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don concludes his garden tour of Italy in the wealthy north where, in the Veneto and Lucca, extravagant pleasure gardens were created for flirtation and fun. In the Lakes, Monty meets up with the garden society, the Grandi Giardini Italiani, to peer over the fence at luxurious creations of the rich and famous. The journey ends on Lake Maggiore to see the most theatrical horticultural gem of Italy.

700407.title: Monty Don's Paradise Gardens
700407.description: In Morocco, Monty discovers the wide variety of paradise gardens. He begins just outside the city of Marrakesh in an enormous royal walled meadow, The Agdal. From there he moves to the heart of the town where he comes upon a tiny garden where huge banana plants jostle with palms to create a secret paradise garden, a shelter from the busy world outside. And in another part of the city a rundown old palace has been turned into a stunning contemporary garden with a twist.

700407.title: Monty Don's Paradise Gardens
700407.description: In Turkey Monty is dazzled by an extraordinary display of the Ottoman Empire's favourite flower, the tulip, and learns of its sacred significance. Travelling further East to India he encounters a new type of spirituality in the tomb gardens of the Mughal Empire. Stunning mausoleums were set in vast gardens as places where an earthly king could enter a divine paradise.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty Don reveals what to plant for fragrance during summer before turning his attention to his herb garden, cutting back marjorman, rosemary and thyme to ensure abundance for the rest of the summer, and sharing tips on how to propagate culinary herbs. Meanwhile, Rachel de Thame seeks out intoxicating scents on a visit to RHS Harlow Carr.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: As the garden reaches an abundance of growth in August, it's the pond, hedges, and edges of the garden which are the focus of attention. In the pond the growth of algae is at its height, so Monty recommends some plants which will eventually improve the quality of the water and help to prevent this unwelcome growth. He also gets going on cutting the hedges and mowing the garden.

actionmax.us.title: The Wolfman
actionmax.us.description: Though absent from his ancestral home of Blackmoor for many years, aristocrat Lawrence Talbot returns to find his missing brother at the request of the latter's fiancée, Gwen. He learns that a creature has links to an ancient curse turning people into werewolves when the moon is full. To save the village and protect Gwen, he must slay the bloodthirsty beast, but he contends with a horrifying family legacy. (Horror, Thriller, Action) - 2010

actionmax.us.title: X-Men: First Class
actionmax.us.description: In the early 1960s, during the height of the Cold War, a mutant named Charles Xavier (James McAvoy) meets a fellow mutant named Erik Lehnsherr (Michael Fassbender). Despite their vastly different backgrounds -- Charles grew up with a wealthy family, while Erik lost his parents at Auschwitz -- the two become close friends. As the world teeters on the brink of a nuclear war, Charles and Erik with other mutants join forces to save humanity. However, a situation soon tears the friends apart. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Science fiction) - 2011

actionmax.us.title: Mojave
actionmax.us.description: A down-and-out artist (Garrett Hedlund) has a dangerous and shocking encounter with an evil drifter (Oscar Isaac) in the desert, leading to terrifying consequences when the deadly stranger follows his unsuspecting victim home. (Thriller) - 2015

actionmax.us.title: Gimme Shelter
actionmax.us.description: The landmark documentary about the tragically ill-fated Rolling Stones free concert at Altamont Speedway on December 6, 1969. Only four months earlier, Woodstock defined the Love Generation; now it lay in ruins on a desolate racetrack six miles outside of San Francisco. (Documentary) - 1970

actionmax.us.title: For All Mankind
actionmax.us.description: Directed by Al Reinert and with music scored by Brian Eno, "For All Mankind" provides a testament to NASA's Apollo program of the 1960s and '70s. Composed of actual NASA footage of the missions and astronaut interviews, the documentary offers the viewpoint of the individuals who braved the remarkable journey to the moon and back. While compiling the material for the film, Reinert went through more than six million feet of film of these historic moments. (Documentary) - 1989

actionmax.us.title: Flashpoint
actionmax.us.description: Texas border patrolmen (Kris Kristofferson, Treat Williams) find a jeep, a skeleton and $800,000 in cash dating from 1963. (Action) - 1984

actionmax.us.title: Full Metal Jacket
actionmax.us.description: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hue. (War, Historical drama) - 1987

actionmax.us.title: Horizon: An American Saga: Chapter 1
actionmax.us.description: In 1859 families discover the lure of the Old West as they settle in territories from Wyoming to Kansas. Meanwhile, a gruff cowboy soon finds himself on the run with a prostitute and a young boy after killing a fellow gunman. (Western, Drama) - 2024

actionmax.us.title: Lord of the Flies
actionmax.us.description: Amidst a nuclear war, a plane carrying a group of schoolboys crash lands on a deserted island. With no adult survivors, the boys are forced to fend for themselves. At first, they cooperate, but when they split into two separate camps -- one led by the pragmatic Ralph (James Aubrey) and the other by militaristic Jack (Tom Chapin) -- their society falls into disarray, leading to a disturbing examination of human nature and a chilling conclusion. (Drama, Adventure, Thriller) - 1963

actionmax.us.title: Scanners
actionmax.us.description: Scanners are men and women born with incredible telepathic and telekinetic powers. There are many who exercise the benefits of their special gifts in a safe and judicious manner. However, there is a group of renegade scanners who plan to create a race that will rule the world. (Science fiction, Horror, Thriller) - 1981

actionmax.us.title: Carrie
actionmax.us.description: In this chilling adaptation of Stephen King's horror novel, withdrawn and sensitive teen Carrie White (Sissy Spacek) faces taunting from classmates at school and abuse from her fanatically pious mother (Piper Laurie) at home. When strange occurrences start happening around Carrie, she begins to suspect that she has supernatural powers. Invited to the prom by the empathetic Tommy Ross (William Katt), Carrie tries to let her guard down, but things eventually take a dark and violent turn. (Horror) - 1976

actionmax.us.title: Camp Hell

actionmax.us.title: Bring Her Back

actionmax.us.title: Shut In
actionmax.us.description: Mary Portman is a widowed child psychologist who lives in isolation in rural Maine. The horrific car accident that killed her husband also left her 18-year-old stepson Stephen in a bedridden, catatonic state, leaving him completely dependent on her. When one of Portman's young patients vanishes without a trace, she becomes convinced that the boy's ghost is now in the house as a dangerous ice storm starts to wreak havoc outside. actionmax.us.title: Black Adam

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Wolfman
cinemaxaction.us.description: Though absent from his ancestral home of Blackmoor for many years, aristocrat Lawrence Talbot returns to find his missing brother at the request of the latter's fiancée, Gwen. He learns that a creature has links to an ancient curse turning people into werewolves when the moon is full. To save the village and protect Gwen, he must slay the bloodthirsty beast, but he contends with a horrifying family legacy. (Action, Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2010-02-11

cinemaxaction.us.title: X-Men: First Class
cinemaxaction.us.description: In the early 1960s, during the height of the Cold War, a mutant named Charles Xavier (James McAvoy) meets a fellow mutant named Erik Lehnsherr (Michael Fassbender). Despite their vastly different backgrounds -- Charles grew up with a wealthy family, while Erik lost his parents at Auschwitz -- the two become close friends. As the world teeters on the brink of a nuclear war, Charles and Erik with other mutants join forces to save humanity. However, a situation soon tears the friends apart. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie, Science Fiction) - 2011-06-02

cinemaxaction.us.title: Mojave

(Action, Adventure, Movie, Thriller) - 2015-04-18

cinemaxaction.us.title: Gimme Shelter
cinemaxaction.us.description: The landmark documentary about the tragically ill-fated Rolling Stones free concert at Altamont Speedway on December 6, 1969. Only four months earlier, Woodstock defined the Love Generation; now it lay in ruins on a desolate racetrack six miles outside of San Francisco. (Documentary, Movie, Music) - 1970-12-06

cinemaxaction.us.title: For All Mankind
cinemaxaction.us.description: Directed by Al Reinert and with music scored by Brian Eno, "For All Mankind" provides a testament to NASA's Apollo program of the 1960s and '70s. Composed of actual NASA footage of the missions and astronaut interviews, the documentary offers the viewpoint of the individuals who braved the remarkable journey to the moon and back. While compiling the material for the film, Reinert went through more than six million feet of film of these historic moments. (Documentary, History, Movie) - 1989-11-01

cinemaxaction.us.title: Flashpoint

cinemaxaction.us.title: Full Metal Jacket
cinemaxaction.us.description: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hué. (Drama, Historical drama, Movie, War) - 1987-06-01

cinemaxaction.us.title: Horizon: An American Saga: Chapter 1

cinemaxaction.us.title: Lord of the Flies
cinemaxaction.us.description: Amidst a nuclear war, a plane carrying a group of schoolboys crash lands on a deserted island. With no adult survivors, the boys are forced to fend for themselves. At first, they cooperate, but when they split into two separate camps -- one led by the pragmatic Ralph (James Aubrey) and the other by militaristic Jack (Tom Chapin) -- their society falls into disarray, leading to a disturbing examination of human nature and a chilling conclusion. (Adventure, Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 1963

cinemax.us.title: Halloween: The Curse of Michael Myers
cinemax.us.description: This installment marks the return of the seemingly indestructible masked murderer Michael Myers (George P. Wilbur), who is targeting Tommy Doyle (Paul Stephen Rudd), a young man tied into the legacy of the killer and his connections with the Strode family. As the supernatural elements of Michael's macabre abilities are explored, his longtime adversary, Dr. Sam Loomis (Donald Pleasence), is also back in yet another attempt to stop the psychopath's brutal rampages. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 1995

cinemax.us.title: Halloween H20: 20 Years Later
cinemax.us.description: Two decades after surviving a massacre on October 31, 1978, former babysitter Laurie Strode finds herself hunted by persistent knife-wielder Michael Myers. Laurie now lives in Northern California under an assumed name, where she works as the headmistress of a private school. But it's not far enough to escape Myers, who soon discovers her whereabouts. As Halloween descends upon Laurie's peaceful community, a feeling of dread weighs upon her -- with good reason. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 1998

cinemax.us.title: Halloween: Resurrection
cinemax.us.description: He's back for more... When a group of teens wins a contest to spend a night in Michael Myers' childhood home to be broadcast live on the Internet, they believe they are in for a little fun and some free publicity. But things go frightfully wrong and the game turns into a struggle to make it out of the house alive. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 2002

cinemax.us.title: Opus
cinemax.us.description: A journalist is invited to the remote compound of a legendary pop star who mysteriously disappeared 30 years ago. Surrounded by the star's cult of sycophants, she gets caught in the middle of his twisted plan. (Thriller, Horror, Comedy) - 2025

cinemax.us.title: Space Jam
cinemax.us.description: Swackhammer (Danny DeVito), an evil alien theme park owner, needs a new attraction at Moron Mountain. When his gang, the Nerdlucks, heads to Earth to kidnap Bugs Bunny (Billy West) and the Looney Tunes, Bugs challenges them to a basketball game to determine their fate. The aliens agree, but they steal the powers of NBA basketball players, including Larry Bird (Larry Bird) and Charles Barkley (Charles Barkley) -- so Bugs gets some help from superstar Michael Jordan (Michael Jordan). (Family, Comedy, Adventure, Animated) - 1996

cinemax.us.title: Teen Titans GO! See Space Jam
cinemax.us.description: The Teen Titans gang crosses paths with the Nerdlucks from Space Jam. (Animated, Action, Adventure, Comedy) - 2021

cinemax.us.title: Space Jam: A New Legacy
cinemax.us.description: Superstar LeBron James and his young son, Dom, get trapped in digital space by a rogue AI. To get home safely, LeBron teams up with Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck and the rest of the Looney Tunes gang for a high-stakes basketball game against the AI's digitized champions of the court -- a powered-up roster called the Goon Squad. (Children, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy, Animated) - 2021

cinemax.us.title: Tyler Perry's Madea's Witness Protection
cinemax.us.description: For years, mild-mannered Wall Street banker George Needleman (Eugene Levy) has meandered through life oblivious to his family's dysfunction and his company's malfeasance, but he's forced to wake up when he learns that he's been framed in a mob-backed Ponzi scheme. Placed under federal protection, George and his family are shipped down South to Madea's (Tyler Perry) house, where the no-nonsense matriarch whips them all into shape using her special brand of tough love. (Comedy, Crime drama) - 2012

cinemax.us.title: A Thousand Words
cinemax.us.description: Jack McCall (Eddie Murphy) is a selfish literary agent whose fast-talking ways allow him to close any deal. His next target is New Age guru Dr. Sinja (Cliff Curtis), but the savvy doctor sees right through Jack. A magical tree appears in Jack's yard, and, according to Dr. Sinja, the tree and Jack are connected; every time Jack says a word, a leaf falls from the tree. When the last leaf drops, Jack will die. With just a thousand leaves left, Jack must learn to curb his speech, or he's a goner. (Comedy) - 2012

cinemax.us.title: The Internship
cinemax.us.description: After old-school salesmen Billy and Nick find themselves downsized, Billy decides that, despite their complete lack of technological savvy, they should work for Google. The friends somehow manage to finagle internships at the Internet giant and promptly head out to Silicon Valley. Viewed with disdain by most of their fellow interns, Billy and Nick join forces with the rest of the misfit "nooglers" to make it through a series of competitive team challenges. (Comedy) - 2013

cinemax.us.title: Girls Trip
cinemax.us.description: Best friends Ryan, Sasha, Lisa and Dina are in for the adventure of a lifetime when they travel to New Orleans for the annual Essence Festival. Along the way, they rekindle their sisterhood and rediscover their wild side by doing enough dancing, drinking, brawling and romancing to make the Big Easy blush. (Comedy, Drama, Adventure) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: The Dilemma
cinemax.us.description: Longtime friends Ronny (Vince Vaughn) and Nick (Kevin James) are partners in an auto-design firm. They are hard at work on a presentation for a dream project that would really launch their company. Then Ronny spots Nick's wife out with another man, and in the process of investigating the possible affair, he learns that Nick has a few secrets of his own. As the presentation nears, Ronny agonizes over what might happen if the truth gets out. (Comedy) - 2011

cinemax.us.title: Crazy, Stupid, Love.
cinemax.us.description: Cal Weaver (Steve Carell) is living the American dream. He has a good job, a beautiful house, great children and a beautiful wife, named Emily (Julianne Moore). Cal's seemingly perfect life unravels, however, when he learns that Emily has been unfaithful and wants a divorce. Over 40 and suddenly single, Cal is adrift in the fickle world of dating. Enter, Jacob Palmer (Ryan Gosling), a self-styled player who takes Cal under his wing and teaches him how to be a hit with the ladies. (Romantic comedy) - 2011

cinemax.us.title: The Hangover Part II
cinemax.us.description: Two years after the disastrous events in Las Vegas, it is now Stu's (Ed Helms) turn to walk down the aisle. Since his bride is from Thailand, Stu decides to hold the wedding there. Desperately hoping to avoid the mayhem of Doug's (Justin Bartha) bachelor party, Stu chooses what he thinks will be a safe option: an alcohol-free, pre-wedding brunch. But this being Thailand, and with Phil (Bradley Cooper) and Alan (Zach Galifianakis) again in attendance, anything can happen. (Comedy) - 2011

cinemax.us.title: The Switch
cinemax.us.description: Neurotic Wally Mars has one bright spot in his life: his friendship with Kassie. When Kassie announces her intention to become pregnant using a sperm donor, Wally thinks he will be the lucky guy, but Kassie has someone else in mind. While drunk at Kassie's insemination party, Wally substitutes his sperm for the donor's, then passes out, remembering nothing. Seven years later, Wally meets Kassie's son, who seems oddly familiar to him. (Romantic comedy) - 2010

cinemaxwest.us.title: Joker: Folie à Deux
cinemaxwest.us.description: Struggling with his dual identity, failed comedian Arthur Fleck stumbles upon true love while incarcerated at Arkham State Hospital. Awaiting trial for the murder of five people, Fleck soon discovers the music that's always been inside him. (Musical, Crime drama, Thriller) - 2024

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Foundation of Lies

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Unholy Vows
hln.us.description: Romanian archbishop Valerian D. Trifa, living in the U.S., is accused of being a Nazi war criminal, and forensic experts find evidence on an incriminating, 40-year-old postcard. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2000-12-05

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Broken Promises
hln.us.description: Investigators look into the shooting death of Russ Stager, a popular gym teacher, and discover that his death was not an accident; a message the victim recorded before his death reveals a story of greed. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2000-12-12

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Time Will Tell
hln.us.description: A money launderer is found dead in the ocean and the only obvious clues to his identity are a Rolex watch and a tattoo; the anchor with which he is weighed down proves most helpful in solving the crime. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2000-12-19

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Second Shot at Love
hln.us.description: The apparent suicide of Dr. Darryl Sutorius, a respected heart surgeon, is questioned when an investigation reveals his new wife's violent history. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2000-12-26

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Journey to Justice
hln.us.description: The 1992 hit-and-run death of 6-year-old Nicole Rae Walker leads to a groundbreaking trial as experts submit a video reconstruction of the incident, implicating a drunk driver and demonstrating the viability of video testimony. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2001-01-02

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Video Diary
hln.us.description: Specialists including a NASA vendor help police reconstruct a damaged surveillance video to catch the murderer of convenience store employee Wanda Mason in Lansing, Mich. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2001-01-09

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Deadly Knowledge
hln.us.description: When a young woman goes missing, the police investigation reveals that she led a double life -- student by day, call-girl by night -- but when her body is discovered, even more strange truths are uncovered. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2000-12-05

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Missing in Time
hln.us.description: A tiny clue inside a suspect's watchband and a popular television show help solve the case of a woman's disappearance. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2001-05-07

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Missing Pearl
hln.us.description: One year after Maine resident Pearl A. Bruns' disappearance, forensic technology helps to find her body and determine who was responsible for her death. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2001-05-21

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Man's Best Friend?
hln.us.description: When 4-year-old April Renee Tucker is found dead in her backyard, her parents tell the police that neighborhood dogs attacked and killed her, but the injuries on her body don't match their account of what happened. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2001-06-04

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Hand Delivered
hln.us.description: San Diego police investigate the murder of a missing person whose hands turn up in a dumpster; an anonymous letter, containing details only the killer would know, offers clues to solving the case. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2001-06-11

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Death Play
hln.us.description: One year after her father's death, a teen's role in a high school production of "Hamlet" causes her to reveal the chilling truth behind her family's tragedy. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2001-06-18

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Fire Dot Com
hln.us.description: A mother puts her hope on the internet and an independent investigation to clear her name after authorities charge her with murdering her 17-month-old son in a fire considered to be intentionally set. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2001-06-25

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Mistaken for Dead
hln.us.description: When a man dies unexpectedly in the office of a noted California doctor, police begin what they think will be a routine investigation, but discoveries of false identities and insurance fraud raise questions about the doctor's role. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2001-07-02

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Frozen Evidence
hln.us.description: A forensic scientist uses his skills to preserve a footprint left in snow to help authorities nab two men suspected of robbing an Ontario couple and shooting the husband in the head. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2001-07-09

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Soft Touch
hln.us.description: Fingerprints taken from a piece of cloth help solve the rape and murder of a 22-year-old woman in Henrico County, Va. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2001-07-16

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Church Disappearance
hln.us.description: The FBI profiles a suspect in the kidnapping and murder of a 6-year-old girl during an evening church service; a witness leads authorities to the likely killer, but then becomes a victim herself. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2001-07-23

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Photo Finish
hln.us.description: Photographs found in a dumpster lead to the killer of Los Angeles model Linda Sobek; the man claims he did not intentionally kill her despite evidence to the contrary. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2001-07-30

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Whodunit
hln.us.description: A murder mystery theater performance in Easton, Md., turns into a real-life mystery when a body is found after the performance ends. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2001-08-06

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Horse Play
hln.us.description: When a woman dies in a horseback riding accident, police uncover a web of lies in her husband's background after his suspicious behavior prompts a closer look. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2001-08-13

mgmplushits.us.title: Back to School
mgmplushits.us.description: Thornton Melon (Rodney Dangerfield) is concerned that his son Jason (Keith Gordon) is unsure whether to go to college, so the uneducated self-made millionaire encourages him by signing up as a student as well. As Jason tries to establish himself among his peers and make the diving team, Thornton falls for a pretty professor (Sally Kellerman) and gets others do his schoolwork for him. When the suspicious dean (Paxton Whitehead) finds out, Thornton needs to show he can get by on his own. (Comedy) - 1986

mgmplushits.us.title: Midnight Cowboy
mgmplushits.us.description: Convinced of his irresistible appeal to women, Texas dishwasher Joe Buck (Jon Voight) quits his job and heads for New York City, thinking he'll latch on to some rich dowager. New York, however, is not as hospitable as he imagined, and Joe soon finds himself living in an abandoned building with a Dickensian layabout named Enrico Ratso Rizzo (Dustin Hoffman). The two form a rough alliance, and together they kick-start Joe's hustling career just as Ratso's health begins to deteriorate. (Drama) - 1969

mgmplushits.us.title: Dead Man Walking
mgmplushits.us.description: As death row inmate Matthew Poncelet (Sean Penn) nears his execution date, he calls upon Sister Helen Prejean (Susan Sarandon) to help him with one last appeal, maintaining that he is innocent of the murders of a young couple. Poncelet begins to form a bond with Prejean, and she visits both his family and the relatives of the victims, hoping to learn more about the case. As things begin to look bleak for Poncelet, Prejean does all that she can to comfort and console the hardened convict. (Crime drama) - 1995

mgmplushits.us.title: Betrayed
mgmplushits.us.description: Following the murder of a radio personality in Chicago, all evidence of the crime points to a white supremacist group from Iowa. With the FBI on the case, the department sends inexperienced agent Catherine Weaver (Debra Winger) on an undercover mission to root out the killers. Falling for her guise, local farmer and suspect Gary Simmons (Tom Berenger) fully embraces Weaver into the community. As Weaver spends more time with Simmons, her belief in his guilt diminishes and love takes its place. (Thriller) - 1988

mgmplushits.us.title: A Bridge Too Far
mgmplushits.us.description: Late in 1944, the Allies seem to have the upper hand in the European land war. A combined British and American paratrooper force, led by American general Gavin and British general Urquhart (Sean Connery), plans to take a highway leading from the Netherlands into Germany, so that British ground troops led by Lieutenant General Horrocks (Edward Fox) and Lieutenant Colonel Vandeleur (Michael Caine) can enter enemy territory. But the Allies soon learn that they may be overconfident. (War, Docudrama) - 1977

mgmplushits.us.title: Preparation for the Next Life
mgmplushits.us.description: A Uyghur woman moves to New York City where she finds herself laboring in Chinatown's underground kitchens. She fatefully encounters Skinner, a young American soldier who's just returned from three tours in the Middle East. As they start to fall in love, they discover the possibility of a better life together than the ones they believed they were destined to live alone. (Romance, Drama) - 2025

mgmplushits.us.title: Lions for Lambs
mgmplushits.us.description: Inspired by their idealistic professor, Dr. Mallery (Robert Redford), to do something meaningful with their lives, Arian (Derek Luke) and Ernest (Michael Peña) join the military and ship out to Afghanistan. Their experiences tie together two separate but related stories. In California, Mallery tries to break through to a disaffected student, while in Washington, D.C., a presidential hopeful (Tom Cruise) prepares to give a journalist (Meryl Streep) the scoop of a lifetime. (Drama) - 2007

mgmplushits.us.title: Ironweed
mgmplushits.us.description: In Depression-era Albany, N.Y., erstwhile baseball star Francis Phelan has become an alcoholic vagabond after guilt over accidentally killing his infant son led him to desert his family. Over the course of several days, he ambles from gritty job to dirty bar to makeshift sleeping quarters. By chance, he encounters fellow itinerant drinker and his sometime lover, Helen Archer. Together, they wax nostalgic about their haunted pasts. (Drama) - 1987

mgmplushits.us.title: The Cider House Rules
mgmplushits.us.description: The film follows the life of Homer Wells (Tobey Maguire), a precocious orphan who leaves his lifelong home and his loving tutor, Dr. Larch (Michael Caine) to explore the world. While Homer struggles to make a life for himself on his own, he must make monumental decisions that will change the course of his future and deeply affect the lives of those around him. (Drama, Romance) - 1999

mgmplushits.us.title: Hustle & Flow
mgmplushits.us.description: DJay is a pimp living day to day on the tough streets of Memphis, Tennessee. Pushing 40, he's tired of the life he's living and dreams of something greater. When he meets up with an old friend who is now in the recording industry, he's inspired to turn his life around and uses his criminal life as an inspiration to create rap music. When he hears that a rap superstar is coming to town, DJay works a hustle to gain the rapper's attention and hopefully get signed by a label. (Crime drama, Music, Hip-Hop & rap) - 2005

mgmplushits.us.title: Coach Carter
mgmplushits.us.description: In 1999, Ken Carter (Samuel L. Jackson) returns to his old high school in Richmond, California, to get the basketball team into shape. With tough rules and academic discipline, he succeeds in setting the players on a winning streak. But when their grades start to suffer, Carter locks them out of the gym and shuts down their championship season. When he is criticized by the players and their parents, he sticks to his guns, determined that they excel in class as well as on the court. (Drama, Biography) - 2005

mgmplushits.us.title: Blue Chips
mgmplushits.us.description: Pete Bell (Nick Nolte) is a college basketball coach who has to improve his team's standing -- by any means necessary. His hopes are pinned on a trio of talented players: Neon Boudeaux (Shaquille O'Neal), Butch McRae (Penny Hardaway) and Ricky Roe (Matt Nover). But in order to get them to sign to his school, Bell will have to illegally pay the players off. If he's caught, it could destroy Bell's coaching career and cast a cloud of shame over his team. Will he risk it all to win? (Drama) - 1994

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Species
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: When government scientist Xavier Fitch (Ben Kingsley) intercepts a space transmission containing the genetic sequence for an alien life form, he uses it to produce "Sil" (Natasha Henstridge) -- a gorgeous alien-human hybrid. As Fitch's team grows concerned at her rapid rate of growth, Sil wrecks the laboratory and begins a violent quest for a suitable male human to impregnate her. The U.S. government dispatches top assassin Preston Lennox (Michael Madsen) and a team of experts to stop her. (Science fiction, Horror) - 1995

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Species II
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Having just returned from a mission to Mars, Commander Ross (Justin Lazard) isn't exactly himself. He's slowly becoming a terrifying alien entity with one goal -- to procreate with human women! When countless women suffer gruesome deaths after bearing half-alien offspring, scientist Laura Baker (Marg Helgenberger) and hired assassin Press Lennox (Michael Madsen) use Eve (Natasha Henstridge), a more tempered alien clone, to find Ross and his brood. Before long Eve escapes to mate with Ross. (Science fiction, Action, Horror, Thriller) - 1998

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Audrey Rose
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Husband and wife Janice (Marsha Mason) and Bill Templeton (John Beck) lead a pleasant life, residing in New York and sending their daughter, Ivy (Susan Swift), to a good school. Things change, though, when the odd Elliot Hoover (Anthony Hopkins) arrives and tells the couple that, after having spent time in India, he believes Ivy is the reincarnated spirit of his daughter, who died years earlier. The Templetons scoff, but ensuing supernatural events soon turn their lives upside down. (Horror) - 1977

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Unforgiven
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: When prostitute Delilah Fitzgerald (Anna Thomson) is disfigured by a pair of cowboys in Big Whiskey, Wyoming, her fellow brothel workers post a reward for their murder, much to the displeasure of sheriff Little Bill Daggett (Gene Hackman), who doesn't allow vigilantism in his town. Two groups of gunfighters, one led by aging former bandit William Munny (Clint Eastwood), the other by the florid English Bob (Richard Harris), come to collect the reward, clashing with each other and the sheriff. (Western) - 1992

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Invasion of the Body Snatchers
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: This remake of the classic horror film is set in San Francisco. Matthew Bennell assumes that when a friend complains of her husband's strange mood, it's a marital issue. However, he begins to worry as more people report similar observations. His concern is confirmed when writer Jack Bellicec and his wife discover a mutated corpse. Besieged by an invisible enemy, Bennell must work quickly before the city is consumed. (Science fiction) - 1978

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: A Quiet Place
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: If they hear you, they hunt you. A family must live in silence to avoid mysterious creatures that hunt by sound. Knowing that even the slightest whisper or footstep can bring death, Evelyn and Lee are determined to find a way to protect their children while desperately searching for a way to fight back. (Horror, Science fiction, Thriller) - 2018

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Deep Water
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Terror strikes when a flight from Los Angeles to Shanghai goes down in the Pacific Ocean. Stuck on a sinking plane, survivors soon find themselves in a fight for their lives as man-eating sharks start to circle the wreckage. (Horror, Thriller) - 2026

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Annihilation
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Lena, a biologist and former soldier, joins a mission to uncover what happened to her husband inside Area X -- a sinister and mysterious phenomenon that is expanding across the American coastline. Once inside, the expedition discovers a world of mutated landscapes and creatures, as dangerous as it is beautiful, that threatens both their lives and their sanity. (Science fiction, Adventure, Thriller) - 2018

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Eye of the Needle
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: A ruthless German spy who goes by the name of Henry Faber (Donald Sutherland) is on his way back home from England after gathering information about the D-Day invasion for Hitler. Henry, who is actually the "Needle," a name that refers to his favorite method of killing, becomes stranded on Storm Island with Lucy (Kate Nelligan) and her husband, David (Christopher Cazenove). Lucy's strained relationship with her disabled husband leaves her vulnerable to Henry's charms. (Thriller) - 1981

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: The Package
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Army Sgt. Johnny Gallagher (Gene Hackman) is reassigned after he angers Col. Glen Whitacre (John Heard) at a meeting of American and U.S.S.R. military types. Gallagher's new job is to shepherd detainee Thomas Boyette (Tommy Lee Jones) from Europe to the U.S. But when Gallagher loses track of his prisoner, he asks his ex-wife, a servicewoman with access to Boyette's background data, for help. As the chase leads Gallagher to Chicago, the intrigue ramps up in a way he couldn't have imagined. (Thriller) - 1989

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: September 5
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: During the 1972 Munich Olympics, an American sports broadcasting crew finds itself thrust into covering the hostage crisis involving Israeli athletes. (Thriller, Historical drama) - 2024

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Ronin
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Deirdre (Natascha McElhone) puts together a team of experts that she tasks with stealing a valuable briefcase, the contents of which are a mystery. The international team includes Sam (Robert De Niro), an ex-intelligence officer, along with Vincent (Jean Reno), Gregor (Stellan Skarsgard) and others. As their operation gets underway, several team members are found to be untrustworthy, and everyone must complete the mission with a watchful eye on everyone else. (Action, Crime drama, Thriller) - 1998

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: To Live and Die in L.A.
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: When his longtime partner on the force is killed, reckless U.S. Secret Service agent Richard Chance (William L. Petersen) vows revenge, setting out to nab dangerous counterfeit artist Eric Masters (Willem Dafoe). Along with his new, straitlaced partner, John Vukovich (John Pankow), Chance sets up a scheme to entrap Masters, resulting in the accidental death of an undercover officer. As Chance's desire for justice becomes an obsession, Vukovich questions the lawless methods he employs. (Crime drama) - 1985

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: The Package
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Army Sgt. Johnny Gallagher (Gene Hackman) is reassigned after he angers Col. Glen Whitacre (John Heard) at a meeting of American and U.S.S.R. military types. Gallagher's new job is to shepherd detainee Thomas Boyette (Tommy Lee Jones) from Europe to the U.S. But when Gallagher loses track of his prisoner, he asks his ex-wife, a servicewoman with access to Boyette's background data, for help. As the chase leads Gallagher to Chicago, the intrigue ramps up in a way he couldn't have imagined. (Thriller) - 1989

mgmplus.us.title: American Hostage - A Taste of Indianapolis
mgmplus.us.description: Fred, in trying to talk Tony through a dark period of despondency, ends up revealing deep personal truths that have repercussions for his marriage. (Crime, Thriller) - 2026-10-04

mgmplus.us.title: A Tale of Two Cities - Resurrection Man
mgmplus.us.description: As the Revolution descends into bloodshed, Charles is arrested in Paris; desperate to save him, Lucie turns to Sydney Carton, but at Charles' trial, a revelation changes everything; as Thérèse seeks vengeance, Sydney weighs up an epic sacrifice. (Historical drama, Miniseries) - 2026-10-04

mgmplus.us.title: Shine a Light
mgmplus.us.description: Filmmaker Martin Scorsese documents the Rolling Stones' energetic performance at New York's Beacon Theatre. The concert, filmed in 2006, features Stones standards and favorites, plus guest appearances by Buddy Guy, Christina Aguilera and Jack White III. Scorsese takes note of the band's long career with music clips and interviews from previous decades. (Documentary) - 2008

mgmplus.us.title: Flesh & Blood
mgmplus.us.description: After being hired for an aborted coup, a group of unscrupulous warriors is abruptly disbanded. One of the mercenaries, Martin (Rutger Hauer), is determined to get revenge on his dismissive employer, Arnolfini (Fernando Hillbeck). To carry out his plan, Martin abducts the lovely Agnes (Jennifer Jason Leigh), the intended wife of Arnolfini's son, Steven (Tom Burlinson). Soon Martin and Steven are locked in an ongoing battle to see who will ultimately win the hand of Agnes. (Adventure, Drama, Action) - 1985

mgmplus.us.title: Hannah and Her Sisters
mgmplus.us.description: Three successive family Thanksgiving dinners mark time for Hannah (Mia Farrow), her younger sisters Lee (Barbara Hershey) and Holly (Dianne Wiest) and the men in their lives. Lee is having an affair with Hannah's husband, Elliot (Michael Caine), and trying to end her Svengali-like romance with artist Frederick (Max von Sydow). Holly is frustrated by her lack of career fulfillment and her increasing dependence on Hannah's largesse, while being courted by the hypochondriac Mickey (Woody Allen). (Comedy drama) - 1986

mgmplus.us.title: Acrimony
mgmplus.us.description: When Melinda met Robert, she was skeptical of his charming nature but couldn't deny how attracted she was to him. Once they fell in love, Melinda molded herself into everything he wanted her to be. She sacrificed for him, worked to support his grandiose dreams, and put up with him for better or for worse. Then, one day she realized that after all she had done, another woman was reaping the lavish rewards. That's when Melinda lost it, and now she cannot let it go. (Thriller, Drama, Horror, Romance) - 2018

mgmplus.us.title: Hercules
mgmplus.us.description: Now a traveling mercenary, Hercules must once again become a hero to help the benevolent king of Thrace protect his people from a powerful warlord. (Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 2014

mgmplus.us.title: Disturbing Behavior
mgmplus.us.description: Steve Clark (James Marsden) is a newcomer in the town of Cradle Bay, and he quickly realizes that there's something odd about his high school classmates. The clique known as the Blue Ribbons are the eerie embodiment of academic excellence and clean living. But, like the rest of the town, they're a little too perfect. When Steve's rebellious friend Gavin (Nick Stahl) mysteriously joins their ranks, Steve searches for the truth with fellow misfit Rachel (Katie Holmes). (Horror, Mystery, Science fiction) - 1998

mgmplus.us.title: The Believers
mgmplus.us.description: Recently widowed psychiatrist Cal Jamison (Martin Sheen) has just moved back to New York City with his young son, Chris (Harley Cross), in an attempt to start over after his wife's horrific accidental death. Cal takes an assignment helping the police with the investigation of a cult-like and bizarre ritualistic double murder. As Cal gets closer to the truth, he realizes that he and those close to him may be the target of supernatural and deadly forces, and that the enemy is closer than he knows. (Horror, Crime drama) - 1987

mgmplus.us.title: Stigmata
mgmplus.us.description: A young woman with no strong religious beliefs, Frankie Paige (Patricia Arquette) begins having strange and violent experiences, showing signs of the wounds that Jesus received when crucified. When the Vatican gets word of Frankie's situation, a high-ranking cardinal (Jonathan Pryce) requests that the Rev. Andrew Kiernan (Gabriel Byrne) investigate her case. Soon Kiernan realizes that very sinister forces are at work, and tries to rescue Frankie from the entity that is plaguing her. (Thriller) - 1999

mgmplus.us.title: Cold Storage
mgmplus.us.description: Two employees at a self-storage company have the wildest shift of their lives when a parasitic fungus that was sealed by the government escapes. As the temperature rises underground, the highly contagious and rapidly mutating microorganism starts to multiply as it unleashes its brain-controlling, body-bursting terrors on the facility's inhabitants -- human and otherwise. (Horror, Science fiction, Comedy) - 2026

mgmplus.us.title: American Hostage - A Taste of Indianapolis
mgmplus.us.description: Fred, in trying to talk Tony through a dark period of despondency, ends up revealing deep personal truths that have repercussions for his marriage. (Crime, Thriller) - 2026-10-04

mgmplus.us.title: A Tale of Two Cities - Resurrection Man
mgmplus.us.description: As the Revolution descends into bloodshed, Charles is arrested in Paris; desperate to save him, Lucie turns to Sydney Carton, but at Charles' trial, a revelation changes everything; as Thérèse seeks vengeance, Sydney weighs up an epic sacrifice. (Historical drama, Miniseries) - 2026-10-04

mgmplus.us.title: The Institute - The Boy
mgmplus.us.description: Luke Ellis wakes up at The Institute, a facility that abducts teenagers with psychic powers; Ms. Sigsby, the place's charismatic director, claims they're saving the world; Tim Jamieson hides from his haunted past as a small-town night knocker. (Thriller) - 2025-07-13

mgmplus.us.title: The Institute - Shots for Dots
mgmplus.us.description: Luke bonds with the other Front Half residents and begins plotting his escape; Ms. Sigsby manages the fallout from a security breach; in town, Tim begins to look into The Institute, only to find himself caught up in a high-stakes standoff. (Thriller) - 2025-07-13

mgmplus.us.title: The Ring Two
mgmplus.us.description: A female journalist (Naomi Watts) must prevent evil Samara from taking possession of her son's (David Dorfman) soul. (Horror, Thriller, Mystery) - 2005

mgmplus.us.title: Dead Again
mgmplus.us.description: When a mute woman suffering from amnesia arrives at the gates of an old orphanage, private investigator Mike Church is asked to find out who she is. With the help of a hypnotist, the woman regains her voice and recalls vivid memories of a couple from the 1940s torn apart by murder. Church begins to develop feelings for the woman, who he calls Grace, and then discovers he has a connection to the tragic couple from the 40s. (Mystery, Thriller, Drama) - 1991

sbssydney.au.description: S1 E2 Episode 2 Dr Michael Mosley was himself diagnosed with Type 2 diabetes and was determined to reverse this with diet, not drugs. He successfully did so and now wants to encourage Australians to do so.

sbssydney.au.description: S1 E1 The Return Of The Sun It's the first day of spring but winter has a sting in its tail as the country is blanketed with snow. As the sun returns the breeding season finally gets underway.

sbssydney.au.description: S1 E2 The Heat Is On It's the middle of spring and the brightest time of year in Wales. This should be the best of times for wildlife, but the race to breed is on, and predators are on the hunt.

sbssydney.au.description: S1 E6 Tokyo Part 2 Adam Liaw trolls the restaurants of food-crazy Tokyo to find food as diverse as Yakitori made from the reproductive organs of chickens to a degustation delight called 'soil 2013'.

sbssydney.au.title: Paul O'Grady For The Love Of Dogs
sbssydney.au.description: S1 E2 Episode 2 Presenter and comedian Paul O'Grady follows the ups and downs of life at Battersea Dogs and Cats Home as they care for our four-legged friends in need. Today, Paul meets a tiny pregnant Chihuahua.

sbssydney.au.title: Paul O'Grady For The Love Of Dogs
sbssydney.au.description: S1 E3 Episode 3 This week Paul is asked to help dog behaviourist Brian with a dog who has developed an extreme fear of men. Benny is half Rottweiler, half Bull Mastiff, and it seems he may have been abused.

sbssydney.au.title: The Definition Of Happiness
sbssydney.au.description: After surviving a near-death accident, Tim Elwin travels three countries questioning our modern obsession with happiness, and asking why chasing it leaves us feeling worse.

sbssydney.au.description: Monday 5 October 2026 The latest national and international news stories from the BBC News team from London, UK, in English.

sbssydney.au.title: Al Jazeera News Second Edition
sbssydney.au.description: Monday 5 October 2026 In-depth global news from Al Jazeera Satellite Network, Doha, Qatar, in English.

sbssydney.au.description: The uplifting story of Pop Choir, one of Australia's largest community choirs who have 800 members in Melbourne.
