shoxbetwest.us.title: Love & Basketball
shoxbetwest.us.description: Monica (Sanaa Lathan) and Quincy (Omar Epps) are two childhood friends who both aspire to be professional basketball players. Quincy, whose father, Zeke (Dennis Haysbert), plays for the Los Angeles Clippers, is a natural talent and a born leader. Monica is ferociously competitive but sometimes becomes overly emotional on the court. Over the years, the two begin to fall for each other, but their separate paths to basketball stardom threaten to pull them apart. (Romance, Drama) - 2000

shoxbetwest.us.title: Pretty Red Dress
shoxbetwest.us.description: The story of Travis, Candice and their daughter, Kenisha, and their relationships with the same red dress. (Drama) - 2022

shoxbetwest.us.title: Breathe
shoxbetwest.us.description: Maya and her young daughter, Zora, are forced to live underground when Earth is left uninhabitable due to a lack of oxygen. When a mysterious couple arrive and claim to know the fate of Maya's husband, she tentatively agrees to let them into the bunker. However, mother and daughter soon find themselves in a fight for survival when the truth about the strangers comes to light. (Science fiction, Thriller) - 2024

shoxbetwest.us.title: Run
shoxbetwest.us.description: Smugglers, the police, locals and tourists get drawn into a dangerous web of survival, sacrifice and shifting loyalties as Europe faces a surge in migration. (Thriller, Drama) - 2025

shoxbetwest.us.title: 'Til Death Do Us Part
shoxbetwest.us.description: Michael and Madison Roland planned to spend the rest of their lives together, but Michael's controlling ways turn their perfect marriage into an abusive roller-coaster ride that no woman could survive. With the help of her best friend, Madison decides to get away. After adopting a new identity, she meets Alex Stone and learns to love again. All seems well until Michael discovers Madison's whereabouts and re-creates her nightmare. (Thriller, Drama) - 2017

shoxbetwest.us.title: S.O.G.: The Book of Ward
shoxbetwest.us.description: Andre Ward, facing an all-too familiar series of obstacles, defies the odds and silences his critics with an undefeated boxing career, but walks away after choosing his role as a father and a husband over boxing. (Documentary) - 2023

shoxbetwest.us.title: Passion Play: Russell Westbrook
shoxbetwest.us.description: Rare footage and extensive interviews provide insight into the dynamic life and career of NBA player Russell Westbrook. (Special, Documentary, Biography, Basketball) - 2021-10-15

shoxbetwest.us.title: Scary Movie 4
shoxbetwest.us.description: Dim-witted Cindy Campbell (Anna Faris) and her sex-crazed friend, Brenda (Regina Hall), team up with cute-but-clueless Tom Ryan (Craig Bierko) to save the world from a hostile alien invasion, with hints of War of the Worlds, Saw II, Million Dollar Baby and The Village. Celebrity cameos include Carmen Electra, Shaquille O'Neal, Dr. Phil McGraw, Bill Pullman, Molly Shannon and Michael Madsen. (Comedy, Horror) - 2006

shoxbetwest.us.title: Scary Movie V
shoxbetwest.us.description: Much bizarre activity follows after a husband and wife bring their newborn infant home from the hospital. When they realize that a demon is stalking their family, they consult paranormal specialists and install numerous cameras to drive out the pesky spirit. Movies that are spoofed in the familiar format include the "Paranormal Activity" franchise, "Mama," "Sinister," "Evil Dead," "Inception," "Black Swan" and "Rise of the Planet of the Apes." (Comedy) - 2013

shoxbetwest.us.title: Burn Mother...ker, Burn!
shoxbetwest.us.description: A chronicle of how decades of troubled relations between the LAPD and the African-American community served as the prelude to the 1992 Los Angeles uprising. (Documentary) - 2017

shoxbetwest.us.title: Kiss the Girls
shoxbetwest.us.description: Successful forensic psychologist Alex Cross (Morgan Freeman) discovers that his niece has gone missing. Once he consults with police Detective Nick Ruskin (Cary Elwes), Cross believes that the disappearance is the work of an insane killer known as "Casanova." Meanwhile, Dr. Kate McTiernan (Ashley Judd) is kidnapped by this criminal and witnesses many other imprisoned women in his lair. After narrowly escaping, McTiernan teams up with Cross to try to apprehend the deranged Casanova. (Mystery, Thriller, Crime drama) - 1997

shoxbetwest.us.title: Scary Movie 4
shoxbetwest.us.description: Dim-witted Cindy Campbell (Anna Faris) and her sex-crazed friend, Brenda (Regina Hall), team up with cute-but-clueless Tom Ryan (Craig Bierko) to save the world from a hostile alien invasion, with hints of War of the Worlds, Saw II, Million Dollar Baby and The Village. Celebrity cameos include Carmen Electra, Shaquille O'Neal, Dr. Phil McGraw, Bill Pullman, Molly Shannon and Michael Madsen. (Comedy, Horror) - 2006

shoxbetwest.us.title: Scary Movie V
shoxbetwest.us.description: Much bizarre activity follows after a husband and wife bring their newborn infant home from the hospital. When they realize that a demon is stalking their family, they consult paranormal specialists and install numerous cameras to drive out the pesky spirit. Movies that are spoofed in the familiar format include the "Paranormal Activity" franchise, "Mama," "Sinister," "Evil Dead," "Inception," "Black Swan" and "Rise of the Planet of the Apes." (Comedy) - 2013

shoxbetwest.us.title: Changing Lanes
shoxbetwest.us.description: A rush-hour fender-bender on New York City's crowded FDR Drive, under most circumstances, wouldn't set off a chain reaction that could decimate two people's lives. But on this day, at this time, a minor collision will turn two complete strangers into vicious adversaries. Their means of destroying each other might be different, but their goals, ultimately, will be the same: Each will systematically try to dismantle the other's life in a reckless effort to reclaim something he has lost. (Thriller, Drama, Action, Mystery, Adventure) - 2002

shoxbetwest.us.title: A Haunted House
shoxbetwest.us.description: Young couple Malcolm (Marlon Wayans) and Kisha (Essence Atkins) have just moved into their dream home. As they settle in, they learn that they're not alone -- not because the house is haunted, but because Kisha is possessed by a demon. Desperate to salvage his relationship -- and more importantly -- his sex life -- Malcolm hires a coterie of paranormal specialists, which includes a priest and ghostbusters, to banish the unwelcome intruder from Kisha's body. (Comedy, Horror) - 2013

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Se7en
showtimeshowcase.us.description: When retiring police Detective William Somerset (Morgan Freeman) tackles a final case with the aid of newly transferred David Mills (Brad Pitt), they discover a number of elaborate and grizzly murders. They soon realize they are dealing with a serial killer (Kevin Spacey) who is targeting people he thinks represent one of the seven deadly sins. Somerset also befriends Mills' wife, Tracy (Gwyneth Paltrow), who is pregnant and afraid to raise her child in the crime-riddled city. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 1995

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Sweet Virginia
showtimeshowcase.us.description: An ex-rodeo rider strikes up a friendship with a young man who may be behind the violence occurring in their small town. (Thriller, Drama) - 2017

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Crimes of the Future
showtimeshowcase.us.description: As the human species adapts to a synthetic environment, the body undergoes new transformations and mutations. Accompanied by his partner, celebrity performance artist Saul Tenser showcases the metamorphosis of his organs. Meanwhile, a mysterious group tries to use Saul's notoriety to shed light on the next phase of human evolution. (Horror, Science fiction) - 2022

showtimeshowcase.us.title: The Dutchman
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Haunted by his crumbling marriage and an identity crisis, a successful but troubled businessman gets drawn into a psychological game of cat and mouse with a sinister, mysterious woman whom he encounters on a New York subway. (Thriller, Drama) - 2025

showtimeshowcase.us.title: The Saint
showtimeshowcase.us.description: A clever thief who is known as the master of creating false identities using the names of Catholic saints, is hired by the Russian Mafia for his next mission. But things get complicated when he falls for Emma Russel, the scientist. (Action) - 1997

showtimeshowcase.us.title: The Perfect Gamble
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Released from prison, two gamblers get entangled with the mafia when they decide to open an illegal casino. (Crime drama) - 2025

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Crawlspace
showtimeshowcase.us.description: After witnessing a brutal murder in a cabin, a man hides in a crawlspace while the killers scour the property for a hidden fortune. As they draw nearer, he must decide if the crawlspace will be his tomb or the battleground in his fight for survival. (Thriller) - 2022

showtimeshowcase.us.title: The Uninvited
showtimeshowcase.us.description: After spending time in a psychiatric facility, young Anna (Emily Browning) finds significant changes in store at home. Her widowed father (David Strathairn) is now engaged to her mother's former nurse, Rachel (Elizabeth Banks). One night, the ghost of Anna's mother appears, screaming for revenge and accusing Rachel of murder. Anna and her sister, Alex (Arielle Kebbel), start to investigate, but they may be unprepared for the lethal battle of wills that ensues. (Horror, Thriller, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery) - 2009

showtimeshowcase.us.title: South Park: Bigger, Longer & Uncut
showtimeshowcase.us.description: In this feature film based on the hit animated series, the third-graders of South Park sneak into an R-rated film by ultra-vulgar Canadian television personalities Terrance (Matt Stone) and Phillip (Trey Parker), and emerge with expanded vocabularies that leave their parents and teachers scandalized. When outraged Americans try to censor the film, the controversy becomes a call to war with Canada, and Terrance and Phillip end up on death row -- with only the kids left to save them. (Animated, Comedy) - 1999

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Coneheads
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Cone-headed extraterrestrials Beldar (Dan Aykroyd) and Prymaat (Jane Curtin) find themselves in New Jersey after a recon mission for their home planet of Remulak goes awry. Stranded, they are forced to live as typical suburban humans. Beldar gets a job, and daughter Connie (Michelle Burke) grows up to be a typical, if oddly shaped, teenager. When INS agents start investigating the family and Beldar receives sinister orders from Remulak, the Coneheads must decide where their allegiance lies. (Comedy, Science fiction) - 1993

showtimeshowcase.us.title: The Faculty
showtimeshowcase.us.description: To the students at Harrington High, the principal and her posse of teachers have always been a little odd, but lately they've been behaving positively alien. Controlled by otherworldly parasites, the faculty try to infect students one by one. Cheerleader Delilah (Jordana Brewster), football player Stan (Shawn Hatosy), drug dealer Zeke (Josh Hartnett) and new girl Marybeth (Laura Harris) team up with some of their other classmates to fight back against the invaders. (Horror, Science fiction, Mystery) - 1998

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Venom
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Gas station owner Ray (Rick Cramer) saves an elderly voodoo priestess trapped inside a wrecked car, but then he opens her mysterious suitcase and becomes possessed by the evil spirits it contains. Ray turns into a murderous zombie, killing anything that crosses his path and terrorizing a group of teens, including his own son, Sean (D.J. Cotrona). With the help and charms of the voodoo priestess, Sean and friends fight to stay alive as they are pursued through the bayou. (Horror, Thriller) - 2005

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Grizzly Night
showtimeshowcase.us.description: On August 12th, 1967, in Montana's Glacier National Park, the unthinkable happens, and on the same night, nine miles apart, there are two fatal grizzly bear attacks. (Drama) - 2025

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Piranha
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Spring break turns gory when an underground tremor releases hundreds of prehistoric, carnivorous fish into Lake Victoria, a popular waterside resort. Local cop Julie Forester (Elisabeth Shue) must join forces with a band of unlikely strangers -- though they are badly outnumbered -- to destroy the ravenous creatures before everyone becomes fish food. (Horror, Thriller) - 2010

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Scream
showtimeshowcase.us.description: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody. (Horror, Comedy) - 1996

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Scream 2
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Sydney (Neve Campbell) and tabloid reporter Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox) survived the events of the first Scream, but their nightmare isn't over. When two college students are murdered at a sneak preview of Stab, a movie based on the events from the first film, it's clear a copycat killer is on the loose. Sydney and Gail, as well as fellow survivors Deputy Dewey (David Arquette) and Randy (Jamie Kennedy) have to find out who is behind this new murder spree, before they all end up dead. (Horror, Comedy) - 1997

showtimeextreme.us.title: It Follows
showtimeextreme.us.description: After carefree teenager Jay (Maika Monroe) sleeps with her new boyfriend, Hugh (Jake Weary), for the first time, she learns that she is the latest recipient of a fatal curse that is passed from victim to victim via sexual intercourse. Death, Jay learns, will creep inexorably toward her as either a friend or a stranger. Jay's friends don't believe her seemingly paranoid ravings, until they too begin to see the phantom assassins and band together to help her flee or defend herself. (Horror, Thriller) - 2014

showtimeextreme.us.title: Basic Instinct
showtimeextreme.us.description: The mysterious Catherine Tramell, a beautiful crime novelist, becomes a suspect when she is linked to the brutal death of a rock star. Investigated by homicide detective Nick Curran, Catherine seduces him into an intense relationship. Meanwhile, the murder case becomes increasingly complicated when more seemingly connected deaths occur and Nick's psychologist and lover, Beth Garner, appears to be another suspect. (Thriller) - 1992

showtimeextreme.us.title: The Harvest
showtimeextreme.us.description: A physician (Samantha Morton) who keeps her dying son completely secluded becomes unhinged when she learns that her new neighbor (Natasha Calis) has secretly befriended the boy. (Thriller, Mystery) - 2013

showtimeextreme.us.title: Phantoms
showtimeextreme.us.description: The resort town of Snowfield, Colo., is under attack by an evil spirit that almost wipes out the entire population, possessing a number of those it kills. As the locals continue to fall victim to the demonic presence, it's up to Sheriff Bryce Hammond (Ben Affleck) to lead the response. He's helped by FBI-employed academic Dr. Timothy Flyte (Peter O'Toole), Deputy Stu Wargle (Liev Schreiber), local doctor Jennifer Pailey (Joanna Going) and her visiting sister, Lisa (Rose McGowan). (Horror) - 1998

showtimeextreme.us.title: 10 Cloverfield Lane
showtimeextreme.us.description: After surviving a car accident, Michelle (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) wakes up to find herself in an underground bunker with two men. Howard (John Goodman) tells her that a massive chemical attack has rendered the air unbreathable, and their only hope of survival is to remain inside. Despite the comforts of home, Howard's controlling and menacing nature makes Michelle want to escape. After taking matters into her own hands, the young woman finally discovers the truth about the outside world. (Thriller, Mystery) - 2016

showtimeextreme.us.title: John Carpenter's Escape From L.A.
showtimeextreme.us.description: In 2013, the United States president was exiling all citizens who don't conform to his hyper-conservative views to Los Angeles, which became an island after a huge earthquake. But, when the president's daughter nabs the detonator to her dad's apocalyptic weapon and sneaks into L.A. to be with the rebel leader she loves, the government taps commando-turned-crook Snake Plissken to retrieve the young woman. And, if he doesn't succeed quickly, he'll be executed. (Action, Adventure, Science fiction, Thriller) - 1996

showtimeextreme.us.title: For Greater Glory: The True Story of Cristiada
showtimeextreme.us.description: In late 1920s Mexico, retired Gen. Gorostieta and his wife watch their country degenerate into violent civil war when the government enacts a series of anti-clerical laws. Gorostieta is at first hesitant to join the rebels, known as Cristeros, until he begins to see the cost of religious persecution on his countrymen. Though the odds are against him, the general nevertheless transforms a ragtag band of rebels into a formidable fighting force. (Historical drama) - 2012

showtimeextreme.us.title: A.I.: Artificial Intelligence
showtimeextreme.us.description: A robotic boy, the first programmed to love, David is adopted as a test case by a Cybertronics employee and his wife. Though he gradually becomes their child, a series of unexpected circumstances make this life impossible for David. Without final acceptance by humans or machines, David embarks on a journey to discover where he truly belongs, uncovering a world in which the line between robot and machine is both vast and profoundly thin. (Science fiction, Fantasy, Drama, Adventure, Thriller) - 2001

showtimeextreme.us.title: Tale of the Mummy
showtimeextreme.us.description: Fifty years ago, Sir Richard Turkel (Christopher Lee) met disaster while exploring the supposedly cursed tomb of the ancient Egyptian tyrant Talos. Now his granddaughter, archaeologist Samantha Turkel (Louise Lombard), eagerly picks up where he left off, delving into its depths to uncover Talos' sarcophagus. But, shortly after the tomb's artifacts are transferred to a London museum, a strange series of murders begins to plague the city. Baffled local detectives enlist Samantha for help. (Horror) - 1998

showtimeextreme.us.title: Gravity
showtimeextreme.us.description: Dr. Ryan Stone is a medical engineer on her first shuttle mission. Her commander is veteran astronaut Matt Kowalsky, helming his last flight before retirement. Then, during a routine space walk by the pair, disaster strikes: The shuttle is destroyed, leaving Ryan and Matt stranded in deep space with no link to Earth and no hope of rescue. As fear turns to panic, they realize that the only way home may be to venture further into space. (Drama, Science fiction, Thriller) - 2013

showtimeextreme.us.title: Quantum of Solace
showtimeextreme.us.description: Following the death of Vesper Lynd, James Bond (Daniel Craig) makes his next mission personal. The hunt for those who blackmailed his lover leads him to ruthless businessman Dominic Greene (Mathieu Amalric), a key player in the organization which coerced Vesper. Bond learns that Greene is plotting to gain total control of a vital natural resource, and he must navigate a minefield of danger and treachery to foil the plan. (Action, Adventure, Thriller) - 2008

showtimeextreme.us.title: The November Man
showtimeextreme.us.description: Five years into his retirement, CIA veteran Peter Devereaux (Pierce Brosnan) is pulled back into service to help retrieve a Russian agent -- also his former lover -- who has incriminating evidence on Federov, a corrupt Russian leader. When a different CIA team, led by Devereaux's former protégé (Luke Bracey), shows up, the mission goes south and Devereaux's ex-lover is killed. Now a rogue agent, Devereaux drags a relief worker (Olga Kurylenko) along on his mission to settle the score. (Action, Thriller, Mystery, Crime drama, Adventure) - 2014

showtimeextreme.us.title: Pulp Fiction
showtimeextreme.us.description: Vincent Vega and Jules Winnfield are hitmen with a penchant for philosophical discussions. In this ultra-hip, multi-strand crime movie, their storyline is interwoven with those of their boss, gangster Marsellus Wallace; his actress wife, Mia; struggling boxer Butch Coolidge; master fixer The Wolf and a nervous pair of armed robbers, Pumpkin and Honey Bunny. (Crime drama, Dark comedy) - 1994

Enter executive Ben Berry (Matthew McConaughey), who is so confident in his romantic prowess that he thinks he can make any woman fall in love with him in 10 days. starzencoreclassic.us.title: Stone
starzencoreclassic.us.description: Parole officer Jack Mabry is just days from retirement and busy wrapping up the last few cases, including that of Gerald "Stone" Creeson, a thug who burned his grandparents' house to cover up their murders. Creeson is desperate to get out of prison and will do anything to secure his parole, including telling his girlfriend to seduce Mabry. Creeson's manipulations awaken the monster within Mabry, leading to unexpected consequences for them both. (Drama, Thriller) - 2010

starzencoreclassic.us.title: The Target
starzencoreclassic.us.description: A bodyguard (Christopher Lambert) discovers that the prominent businessman (Dennis Hopper) he has been assigned to protect murdered his parents many years earlier. (Thriller, Crime drama, Action) - 2002

starzencoreclassic.us.title: Paranormal Activity
starzencoreclassic.us.description: Soon after moving into a suburban tract home, Katie (Katie Featherston) and Micah (Micah Sloat) become increasingly disturbed by what appears to be a supernatural presence. Hoping to capture evidence of it on film, they set up video cameras in the house but are not prepared for the terrifying events that follow. (Horror, Thriller, Mystery) - 2007

starzencoreclassic.us.title: Lay the Favorite

starzencoreclassic.us.title: Fresh
starzencoreclassic.us.description: Fresh (Sean Nelson) is a 12-year-old drug dealer who finds himself trapped in a web of poverty, corruption and racial tension in Brooklyn, New York. When his drug-addict sister Nichole (N'Bushe Wright) starts sleeping with local drug lord Esteban (Giancarlo Esposito), Fresh calls upon the skills he learned playing chess with his alcoholic father and speed-chess champion Sam (Samuel L. Jackson) and devises a complex strategy that will free both himself and his sister. (Drama) - 1994

starzencoreclassic.us.title: Double Whammy
starzencoreclassic.us.description: Ray Pluto (Denis Leary) has many problems. He is satirized in the tabloids as the "loser cop." His partner (Steve Buscemi) is starting to seem suspiciously attracted to him. A pair of screenwriters (Donald Faison, Keith Nobbs) across the hall keep bugging him for help. The superintendent of his building (Luis Guzmán) is stabbed by hoodlums hired by his own rebellious daughter (Melonie Diaz). To top it off, a sexually aggressive chiropractor (Elizabeth Hurley) may just be Ray's undoing. (Comedy) - 2001

starzencoreclassic.us.title: Happy Endings
starzencoreclassic.us.description: Filmmaker Nicky (Jesse Bradford) offers to track down the son that Mamie (Lisa Kudrow) gave up for adoption nearly two decades before. Meanwhile, Mamie's stepbrother (and the father of her child), Charley (Steve Coogan), along with his boyfriend, Gil, try to find out what became of the sperm Gil donated to a lesbian couple. Finally, singer Jude (Maggie Gyllenhaal) becomes entangled in a love triangle with androgynous drummer Otis (Jason Ritter) and his conservative father (Tom Arnold). (Comedy drama, LGBTQ) - 2005

starzencoreclassic.us.title: Youth in Oregon
starzencoreclassic.us.description: When 79-year-old curmudgeon Raymond (Frank Langella) makes arrangements to be euthanized in Oregon, his family refuses to accept his decision. But when another family emergency arises, Raymond's daughter Kate (Christina Applegate) turns to her husband, Brian (Billy Crudup), for a little help. So Brian reluctantly volunteers to drive the cantankerous Raymond and his wine-loving wife, Estelle (Mary Kay Place), to Oregon. (Comedy drama) - 2016

themoviechannel.us.title: The Crossing Guard
themoviechannel.us.description: For six excruciating years, Freddy Gale (Jack Nicholson) has fantasized about taking bloody revenge on John Booth (David Morse), the drunk driver responsible for the traffic accident that killed his daughter. On the last day of Booth's prison sentence, a grief-stricken Gale informs his ex-wife, Mary (Anjelica Huston), of his intentions, then follows Booth to a mobile home in the suburbs. There, with hands shaking, Gale draws his gun -- and steps into a dark and uncertain future. (Drama) - 1995

themoviechannel.us.title: Asylum
themoviechannel.us.description: An administrator's bored wife (Natasha Richardson) begins a torrid affair with an institutionalized artist (Marton Csokas) who beat his wife to death. (Drama) - 2005

themoviechannel.us.title: Area 51
themoviechannel.us.description: Obsessed with UFOs, a man (Reid Warner) and two friends find evidence of an alien presence at Area 51 in Nevada. (Science fiction, Horror, Mystery) - 2015

themoviechannel.us.title: Carriers
themoviechannel.us.description: When a virus threatens to wipe out humanity, Danny (Lou Taylor Pucci), his brother Brian (Chris Pine), and their friends Bobby (Piper Perabo) and Kate (Emily VanCamp) set out across the desert in the Southwest, trying to elude the pandemic. Over the course of several days, the four friends learn that the darkness within themselves may prove deadlier than any microbe. (Horror, Thriller) - 2009

themoviechannel.us.title: The Devil Inside
themoviechannel.us.description: Twenty years after Maria Rossi (Suzan Crowley) murdered three people, her daughter, Isabella (Fernanda Andrade), seeks the truth about that terrible night. Isabella travels to an Italian hospital for the criminally insane -- where Maria is locked away -- to find out whether her mother is mentally ill or demonically possessed. With the help of two young exorcists (Simon Quarterman, Evan Helmuth), Isabella tries to cure Maria -- and engages four demons in a battle for her mother's soul. (Horror, Thriller) - 2012

themoviechannel.us.title: Rumpelstiltskin
themoviechannel.us.description: A young widow's wish to see her policeman husband one last time frees a demonic being that wants her infant son's soul. (Horror) - 1995

themoviechannel.us.title: The Relic
themoviechannel.us.description: A grieving mother who thinks her child is reaching out to her from beyond holds a seance to communicate and unwittingly unleashes evil in her home. (Horror) - 2025

themoviechannel.us.title: The Harvest
themoviechannel.us.description: A physician (Samantha Morton) who keeps her dying son completely secluded becomes unhinged when she learns that her new neighbor (Natasha Calis) has secretly befriended the boy. (Thriller, Mystery) - 2013

themoviechannel.us.title: The Beldham
themoviechannel.us.description: A struggling new mother fights a generations-old presence lurking within her family's home, threatening her safety, her sanity, and the life of her infant child. (Horror, Thriller) - 2024

themoviechannel.us.title: Airplane II: The Sequel
themoviechannel.us.description: Though haunted by combat memories, heroic pilot Ted Striker (Robert Hays) agrees to return to the cockpit to man the controls of Mayflower One, America's first commercial spacecraft. But, as soon as Mayflower One lifts off, an electrical malfunction sends the ship veering off course. A shaken Striker struggles to guide the shuttle through a treacherous asteroid belt, tame its failing computer systems and stop the disgruntled Joe Seluchi (Sonny Bono) from detonating a deadly bomb on board. (Science fiction, Dark comedy) - 1982

themoviechannel.us.title: Planes, Trains and Automobiles
themoviechannel.us.description: Easily excitable Neal Page (Steve Martin) is somewhat of a control freak. Trying to get home to Chicago to spend Thanksgiving with his wife (Laila Robins) and kids, his flight is rerouted to a distant city in Kansas because of a freak snowstorm, and his sanity begins to fray. Worse yet, he is forced to bunk up with talkative Del Griffith (John Candy), whom he finds extremely annoying. Together they must overcome the insanity of holiday travel to reach their intended destination. (Holiday, Comedy, Adventure) - 1987

themoviechannel.us.title: Edge of Tomorrow
themoviechannel.us.description: When Earth falls under attack from invincible aliens, no military unit in the world is able to beat them. Maj. William Cage (Tom Cruise), an officer who has never seen combat, is assigned to a suicide mission. Killed within moments, Cage finds himself thrown into a time loop, in which he relives the same brutal fight -- and his death -- over and over again. However, Cage's fighting skills improve with each encore, bringing him and a comrade (Emily Blunt) ever closer to defeating the aliens. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2014

themoviechannel.us.title: Top Gun
themoviechannel.us.description: The Top Gun Naval Fighter Weapons School is where the best of the best train to refine their elite flying skills. When hotshot fighter pilot Maverick (Tom Cruise) is sent to the school, his reckless attitude and cocky demeanor put him at odds with the other pilots, especially the cool and collected Iceman (Val Kilmer). But Maverick isn't only competing to be the top fighter pilot, he's also fighting for the attention of his beautiful flight instructor, Charlotte Blackwood (Kelly McGillis). (Action, Adventure, Drama, Romance) - 1986

themoviechannel.us.title: Days of Thunder
themoviechannel.us.description: In the fast-paced world of NASCAR, a rivalry brews between rookie hotshot Cole Trickle (Tom Cruise) and veteran racer Rowdy Burns (Michael Rooker). When both of them are seriously injured in competition, the former bitter rivals become close friends. With Cole's spirits restored by a romance with neurosurgeon Dr. Claire Lewicki (Nicole Kidman), and Rowdy still sidelined by injuries, Cole decides to race Rowdy's car in the Daytona 500 against underhanded newcomer Russ Wheeler (Cary Elwes). (Action, Drama, Romance) - 1990

themoviechannel.us.title: Baby Driver
themoviechannel.us.description: Talented getaway driver Baby relies on the beat of his personal soundtrack to be the best in the game. After meeting the woman of his dreams, he sees a chance to ditch his shady lifestyle and make a clean break. Coerced into working for a crime boss, Baby must face the music as a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom. (Action, Thriller, Crime drama) - 2017

themoviechannel.us.title: The Prophecy II
themoviechannel.us.description: Evil angel Gabriel (Christopher Walken) rises from hell to declare war on God and humanity. To win the spiritual war, Gabriel has to kill Los Angeles nurse Valerie Rosales (Jennifer Beals) -- and, more importantly, her unborn half-angel baby. Helping Gabriel track Rosales down is a suicidal teenager (Brittany Murphy). Meanwhile, good angel Danyael (Russell Wong) marshals all his heavenly powers to protect Rosales and her child from Gabriel's clutches. (Horror) - 1998

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Battleship Potemkin
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When they are fed rancid meat, the sailors on the Potemkin revolt against their harsh conditions. Led by Vakulinchuk, the sailors kill the officers of the ship to gain their freedom. Vakulinchuk is also killed, and the people of Odessa honor him as a symbol of revolution. Tsarist soldiers arrive and massacre the civilians to quell the uprising. A squadron of ships is sent to overthrow the Potemkin, but the ships side with the revolt and refuse to attack. (Historical drama, Thriller) - 1925

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Three Colors: Blue
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Julie (Juliette Binoche) is haunted by her grief after living through a tragic auto wreck that claimed the life of her composer husband and young daughter. Her initial reaction is to withdraw from her relationships, lock herself in her apartment and suppress her pain. But avoiding human interactions on the bustling streets of Paris proves impossible, and she eventually meets up with Olivier (Benoît Régent), an old friend who harbors a secret love for her, and who could draw her back to reality. (Drama) - 1993

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Three Colors: White
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Polish immigrant Karol finds himself out of a marriage, a job and a country when his French wife, Dominique, divorces him after six months due to his impotence. Forced to leave France after losing the business they jointly owned, Karol enlists fellow Polish expatriate Mikołaj to smuggle him back to their homeland. After successfully returning, Karol begins to build his new life, while never forgetting his old one. (Drama) - 1993

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer Story
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Actor Lionel Barrymore and Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer executive Dore Schary present clips from the studio's 1951 releases, including "Quo Vadis." (Documentary) - 1951

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Noah's Ark

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Squall

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Great Divide

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Truth About Youth
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A naive young man becomes enamored of a cabaret singer who has sampled liberally from amongst the male population. (Drama) - 1930

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Naughty Flirt
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A spoiled heiress leaves her boyfriend only to become involved with a man who secretly desires her money. (Drama) - 1931

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Consolation Marriage
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A sportswriter (Pat O'Brien) jilted by his globe-trotting girlfriend (Myrna Loy) marries a woman (Irene Dunne) jilted by her boyfriend. (Comedy) - 1931

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Rebound
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A woman (Ina Claire) tries to make her husband (Robert Ames) forget his old flame (Myrna Loy), who is back. (Comedy drama) - 1931

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Libeled Lady
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When a major newspaper accuses wealthy socialite Connie Allenbury (Myrna Loy) of being a home-wrecker, and she files a multi-million-dollar libel lawsuit, the publication's frazzled head editor, Warren Haggerty (Spencer Tracy), must find a way to turn the tables on her. Soon Haggerty's harried fiancée, Gladys Benton (Jean Harlow), and his dashing friend Bill Chandler (William Powell) are in on a scheme that aims to discredit Connie, with amusing and unexpected results. (Comedy) - 1936

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: I Love You Again
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Larry Wilson (William Powell) is a wealthy businessman. He's also so incredibly boring that his wife, Kay (Myrna Loy), wants a divorce. But when Larry gets knocked on the head, he discovers that he isn't Larry Wilson at all. He's actually George Carey, a con artist, and his life as Larry has really been a case of amnesia. Now back to his old ways, George plans a con to rob an entire town of their money. But George's fiery ways make Kay reconsider the divorce. (Comedy) - 1940

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Love Crazy
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A happily married architect, Steve (William Powell), and his wife, Susan (Myrna Loy), plan a romantic celebration for their fourth anniversary, but their evening is interrupted when Susan's meddling mother, Mrs. Cooper (Florence Bates), stops by for a visit. Later, when Mrs. Cooper eavesdrops on Steve talking with an old flame, Isobel (Gail Patrick), she tells Susan, who files for divorce. Steve, still in love with Susan, decides he must feign insanity to stop the divorce proceedings. (Romantic comedy) - 1941

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Double Wedding
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The industrious Margit Agnew (Myrna Loy) fixes her sister Irene (Florence Rice) up with the sensible but meek Waldo Beaver (John Beal), and the couple soon decides to wed, despite Irene's reservations about her boring fiancé. Things take a sharp turn when Irene makes the acquaintance of eccentric artist Charles Lodge (William Powell), who encourages the young woman to drop Waldo and pursue her dreams. Before long, an irate Margit confronts Charles, but their encounter takes an unexpected turn. (Comedy) - 1937

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E21 Shada The 2017 animated reconstruction of the unaired serial. On the planet Shada, the Time Lords have built a prison for the Universe's most dangerous criminals.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E12 The Creature from the Pit: Part 4 With Erato now able to communicate, the truth of Adrasta’s scheming is revealed but a terrible retribution has already been put in motion.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E13 Nightmare of Eden: Part 1 A terrible hyperspace accident results in two starships becoming locked together. The Doctor arrives and discovers that the incident may have also released a deadly menace.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E14 Nightmare of Eden: Part 2 The Doctor and Romana are horrified to discover that Tryst has been storing real lifeforms in his CET machine and that someone is smuggling the dangerous narcotic, Vraxoin.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E15 Nightmare of Eden: Part 3 The terrifying Mandrels have escaped from Eden and are attacking everyone aboard the Empress. The Doctor and Romana, accused of being smugglers, are pursued by customs officers.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E16 Nightmare of Eden: Part 4 The Doctor solves the mystery of the drug smuggling racket and the culprits are revealed. But unless the Doctor and Romana act quickly, the villains will escape justice.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E17 The Horns of Nimon: Part 1 With the TARDIS disabled in order to undergo repairs, the Doctor is powerless when Romana is kidnapped by a battleship which is on its way to Skonnos and the formidable Nimon.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E18 The Horns of Nimon: Part 2 On Skonnos, Romana and the Athenian youngsters are forced into the labyrinth of the power complex to meet their fate at the hands of the Nimon.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E19 The Horns of Nimon: Part 3 Trapped inside the power complex, the Doctor and Romana begin to suspect that the Nimon is only the first of a full scale invasion.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E20 The Horns of Nimon: Part 4 On the dying world of Crinoth, Romana discovers the truth behind the Nimon’s empty promises. The Doctor must find a way to shut down the power complex on Skonnos.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E21 Shada The 2017 animated reconstruction of the unaired serial. On the planet Shada, the Time Lords have built a prison for the Universe's most dangerous criminals.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E1 The Leisure Hive: Part 1 The Doctor and Romana visit the Leisure Hive on Argolis. The Argolin, survivors of a war, run the Hive as a tourist attraction but its future is jeopardised by a series of deaths.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E2 The Leisure Hive: Part 2 The Tachyon Recreation Generator is the cause of the mysterious deaths at the Leisure Hive. Romana makes repairs, and the Doctor becomes a reluctant guinea pig.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E3 The Leisure Hive: Part 3 The Tachyon Generator has aged the Doctor into a white haired old man, but he discovers the truth behind the machine and uncovers a plot to take control of the Hive.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E4 The Leisure Hive: Part 4 The obsessed Pangol is determined to give Argolis a future with himself as the leader of the reborn race and plans to strike back at the Foamasi.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E5 Meglos: Part 1 On Zolfa-Thura, Meglos plans to steal the ancient and powerful Dodecahedron from the neighbouring world of Tigella. But first, the Doctor must be prevented from interfering.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E6 Meglos: Part 2 Masquerading as the Doctor, Meglos penetrates the underground city of Tigella. The Doctor and Romana are trapped in an ever repeating circle of time and powerless to act.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E7 Meglos: Part 3 While Meglos escapes with the Dodecahedron, the Doctor is mistakenly held responsible for the theft and is sentenced to a gruesome death as punishment for his crime.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E8 Meglos: Part 4 The Doctor must convince the Tigellans of his innocence if he is to prevent Meglos from using the dodecahedron to destroy their world.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E9 Full Circle: Part 1 The TARDIS enters the universe of E-Space and lands on the planet Alzarius where Mistfall is occurring and creatures are stirring in the swamp.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who

The half-hour program covers many aspects of farming to give producers the information they need to make better decisions about their operations. The show's not just about agriculture, though, as it also features regular segments that deal with topics such as food safety, health news, and the people and places of rural America. Anchor Clinton Griffiths leads the show's on-air team. (News, Agriculture)

The Emmy Award-nominated, daily, half-hour syndicated program delivers the inside scoop on the latest breaking entertainment news. "Access" also delves into the latest true crime headlines with insight from leading experts, celebrates local heroes working to make their communities better, and speaks with the people behind the viral moments everyone is talking about. In 2021, "Access Hollywood" was honored at the annual CultureX Conversation Conference with the award for Program Reflection of Inclusion in Television by Multichannel News and Broadcasting + Cable. wdrb.us.title: Young Sheldon
wdrb.us.description: For young Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naive Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son. For 12 years on "The Big Bang Theory," audiences came to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. In "Young Sheldon," audiences get a chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. Jim Parsons, who plays the adult version of Sheldon on "The Big Bang Theory," narrates. (Sitcom) - 2017-09-25

Kimmel's family and friends take part in the festivities, including his Cousin Sal, Uncle Frank (until his death in 2011) and childhood friend Cleto Escobedo III, who leads the show's house band. Recurring segments include the FCC-pleasing This Week in Unnecessary Censorship in which they take TV clips and "bleep and blur things whether they need it or not," as Kimmel describes it. But it's too bad they consistently run out of time for Matt Damon's segment. (Talk, Comedy) - 2003-01-27

discoverywest.us.title: How It's Made

discoverywest.us.title: Contraband: Seized at the Border

discoverywest.us.title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
discoverywest.us.description: S08 E02 Grab Bag Officers find a man and his family driving a suspiciously modified truck; a young man is caught with narcotics strapped to his body; a crosser is detained for having a record of smuggling an illegal migrant across the border.

discoverywest.us.title: Contraband: Seized at the Border

discoverywest.us.title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
discoverywest.us.description: S09 E08 Just Doing My Duty Each year, CBP recovers over 1,300 stolen vehicles at ports of entry. Many are heading to the black market, while cartels use others for trafficking. When officers receive a be on the lookout (BOLO) alert for a luxury car, they take it seriously.

discoverywest.us.title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
discoverywest.us.description: S09 E09 Boomers Behaving Badly Tourist Day celebrates the thousands of Americans who migrate south during the winter months. With 11,000 visitors expected, officers are preparing themselves for festivities fueled by alcohol and drugs.

discoverywest.us.title: Contraband: Seized at the Border ᴺᵉʷ
discoverywest.us.description: For Better ... or Worse Millions of travelers cross the U.S. borders every year. And while some are innocent couples, others are partners in crime. Because at the border, love isn't always what it seems.

discoverywest.us.title: 120 Hours Behind Bars ᴺᵉʷ

discoverywest.us.title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
discoverywest.us.description: S02 E11 Tennessee Dyer County Jail At Tennessee's Dyer County Jail, overcrowding, contraband and violence strain an understaffed facility, where drugs have been smuggled in by officers and violence among inmates has turned deadly.

discoverywest.us.title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
discoverywest.us.description: S02 E03 Suffolk County Correctional Facility As an opioid epidemic grips the county, a law-and-order sheriff uses rehabilitation to help inmates break the cycle of addiction while officers work around the clock to maintain safety, security and order inside one of New York's busiest jails.

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

Tensions rise as Bobby struggles to convince Jimmie to leave the gang that was his only family during the painful years his absent father spent behind bars. (Drama) - 1992

James frames Ford for the murder of Junior (Fredro Starr), the brother of Trey (Ice Cube), who heads the Reapers, a notoriously malicious biker gang. Ford goes on the run in an attempt to clear his name, while the FBI and multiple groups of motorcycle-mounted marauders chase after him. (Action) - 2004

When the pair surfaces, they make out a vessel in the distance, but it does not immediately set in that they have been left behind. With sharks lurking beneath, their survival chances grow smaller. Horton forms a friendship with the mayor of Whoville, Ned McDodd, and promises to transport Whoville to safety. However, Horton encounters opposition from his jungle neighbors, who don't want to believe in the existence of Whoville. (Animated, Children, Adventure) - 2008

This doesn't sit well with their Christmas-obsessed neighbors Vic Frohmeyer (Dan Aykroyd) and Walt Scheel (M. Emmet Walsh), who are determined to win the annual "best decorated street" competition, and the Kranks soon find themselves social outcasts because of their lack of Christmas spirit. His partner, Charles (John Ritter), is similarly unable to keep his hands off the woman he's trailing -- a winsome cheating spouse named Dolores (Dorothy Stratten). (Romantic comedy) - 1981

After a daring escape, Jim hopes to never see Ryder again. But when he witnesses the hitchhiker murdering an entire family, Jim pursues Ryder with the help of truck-stop waitress Nash (Jennifer Jason Leigh), pitting the rivals against each other in a deadly series of car chases and brutal murders. (Thriller) - 1986

cartoonnetwork.us.title: Adventure Time
cartoonnetwork.us.description: Twelve-year-old Finn battles evil in the Land of Ooo; assisted by his magical dog, Jake, Finn roams the Land of Ooo righting wrongs and battling evil; usually that evil comes in the form of the Ice King, who is in search of a wife; he's decided he should wed Princess Bubblegum, though she doesn't want to marry him; still, he persists in trying to steal her away and Finn and Jake, along with Lady Raincorn do their best to keep her from harm. (Animated, Children, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2010-04-05

cartoonnetwork.us.title: We Bare Bears
cartoonnetwork.us.description: Three brother bears awkwardly attempt to find their place in civilized society, whether they're looking for food, trying to make human friends, or scheming to become famous on the internet. Grizzly, Panda and Ice Bear stack atop one another when they leave their cave and explore the hipster environs of the San Francisco Bay Area, and it's clear the siblings have a lot to learn about a technologically driven world. By their side on many adventures are best friend Chloe (the only human character in the cast), fame-obsessed panda Nom Nom, and Charlie, aka Bigfoot. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2015-07-27

cartoonnetwork.us.title: Teen Titans Go!
cartoonnetwork.us.description: This follow-up to the popular "Teen Titans" series takes a more comedic look at the superheroes, showing what life is like for the teens when their capes come off. Funny things happen to Robin, Starfire, Raven, Beast Boy and Cyborg between saving the world and being regular teens, living together without adult supervision. The teens, in their ordinary lives, deal with the everyday issues of adolescence that include such important things as having staring contests to determine who does the laundry and going on a series of quests to construct the perfect sandwich. But, of course, the heroes still fight crime in Jump City when the need arises. Whatever the situation, they're always ready for an adventure -- inside the house or out of it. (Animated, Children, Adventure, Action, Comedy) - 2013-04-23

cartoonnetwork.us.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
cartoonnetwork.us.description: No, this animated series is not about anthropomorphic chewing gum, it's about a young cat named Gumball Watterson. Gumball has a penchant for getting into trouble, often resulting from schemes he comes up with, but he never seems to learn his lesson. Gumball's best friend is a fish named Darwin, who used to be the family pet until he grew legs and became part of the family. Gumball resents his younger sister, Anais, because she is the smartest member of the family. Gumball's mother is the breadwinner in the family, working long hours at the rainbow factory, and his father stays at home watching TV and playing video games. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2011-05-03

backstage.us.description: The gang war in Philadelphia is mostly centered around two rivals: Dame, the ruthless leader of the Umbrella organization, whose money and firepower have put him at the top of the crime world; and Beans, the one-time crime overlord hell-bent on taking back the city. The wild card is El Pollo Loco, a new player on the scene. His strategy involves teaming up with one side against the other -- but in reality, Loco has no plans to share Philadelphia with anyone. (Crime drama) - 2005

backstage.us.description: Frustrated with being broke, "Beans" (Beanie Sigel) decides that the only way to grasp the American Dream is to take it. "State Property" follows Beans and his crew, the ABM as they take over the city, creating mayhem as their empire builds. Beans now struggles to maintain his family life, while bumping heads with opposing gangsters and the police. It all comes to a head when he cannot surpass the city's most notorious crew run by Untouchable J (Jay-Z) and Dame (Damon Dash). (Crime drama) - 2002

backstage.us.title: State Property 2
backstage.us.description: The gang war in Philadelphia is mostly centered around two rivals: Dame, the ruthless leader of the Umbrella organization, whose money and firepower have put him at the top of the crime world; and Beans, the one-time crime overlord hell-bent on taking back the city. The wild card is El Pollo Loco, a new player on the scene. His strategy involves teaming up with one side against the other -- but in reality, Loco has no plans to share Philadelphia with anyone. (Crime drama) - 2005

backstage.us.title: Never 2 Big
backstage.us.description: Freddy (Shemar Moore) is a big-shot music industry executive, whose cousin, Blusette (Salli Richardson), is a successful and well-known singer managed by 8-Ball Harris (Ernie Hudson). Blusette soon realizes, however, that 8-Ball is a small-time crook, hoping to use her and her renown to benefit his various schemes. Blusette tells him to take a hike, and she turns up dead a short while later. Freddy then tries to uncover the truth about Blusette, while 8-Ball works to frame him. (Crime drama) - 1998

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S06 E20 Lost Cause After a painful breakup, Brittany bounces back with new swagger and her sights set on a new man; Ariana blows up at Sandoval for choosing to support Jax over spending time with her; Kristen tries to convince Carter of her loyalty.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S06 E21 Welcome to TomTom Sandoval and Schwartz give their friends a sneak peek at TomTom; Lisa must decide Jax's future at SUR; James receives huge news about his DJ career; Stassi introduces Lisa to her boyfriend with catastrophically awkward results.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S07 E01 A Decent Proposal Lisa Vanderpump finds herself behind schedule on TomTom, the new bar she's opening with Tom Sandoval and Tom Schwartz; James lands in hot water with the group after insulting Brittany; Scheana settles into single life; Jax proposes to Brittany.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S07 E02 Hope and Pride Stassi plans a surprise party to celebrate Jax and Brittany's engagement; James tries to work his way back into the group's good graces; Stassi seeks Lisa's approval for her new beau, Beau.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S07 E03 Either Him or Me James spirals out of control after being ambushed by Kristen at Pride, while his girlfriend, Raquel, struggles to accept new rumors about his alleged infidelity; Jax and Brittany decide to start a beer cheese company.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S07 E04 Lisa's Dilemma Katie's ultimatum forces Lisa Vanderpump to reconsider employing James at SUR; Tom Schwartz and Tom Sandoval display different methods of interviewing staff members for TomTom; Jax and Brittany host a dinner party to debut their beer cheese.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S07 E05 Ice Queens Stassi and Ariana throw an epic winter-themed birthday party; Stassi's new boyfriend gets his first taste of Stassi's bad birthday behavior; Jax confronts Tom Sandoval for questioning his engagement; James finds himself cut off from everyone at SUR.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S07 E06 Love Thy Mother Stassi struggles to make amends with Beau after her meltdown; James tries to rekindle his friendship with Lala; Jax causes trouble at a SUR staff meeting; the Toms present their cocktails to Lisa; Katie, Kristen and Stassi's mothers come to town.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S07 E07 Girls' Night In Katie convinces Lisa to let her host a "Girls' Night In" party, but Billie Lee lashes out at Katie for not including her in the planning; Brittany throws a tantrum; Lala decides James is moving too fast; Stassi creates her own personal holiday.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S07 E08 A Housewarming Divided The group treks to Marina del Rey for Scheana's housewarming; Lala calls out Billie Lee; Tom gossips about Ariana's romantic encounters with women; Lisa Vanderpump finally reveals the fully finished TomTom to a giddy Sandoval and Schwartz.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S07 E09 Tom and Tommer Sandoval and Schwartz scramble to get TomTom ready for its opening event; Kristen learns she's not allowed to come; James erupts when Raquel considers attending Girls' Night In; Jax celebrates his first birthday without the support of his parents.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S07 E10 So Vain in Solvang Lala takes her friends to Solvang, Calif., on a private jet; Jax looks forward to a guys' night out with Tom Sandoval and Tom Schwartz; Brittany brings Jax to therapy to deal with his infidelities; James has a fight with his mother over money.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S07 E11 Return of Crazy Kristen Kristen's bizarre behavior threatens to spoil the women's trip to wine country; Scheana breaks down; James is overjoyed when he gets a last-minute invitation to the guys' "staycation;" Tom Sandoval invites women back to the hotel room.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S07 E12 PJs on the PJ Stassi gives Kristen tough love about her relationship with Carter; Sandoval and Schwartz worry that Lisa may not put their cocktails on the menu; Lisa gives James permission to DJ an event at PUMP; Lala is betrayed by her boyfriend of three years.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S07 E13 Reptilian Brain Stassi desperately wants to make a good impression when she first meets Beau's mom, but her hopes are dashed; Sandoval and Ariana finally have an honest discussion about having kids; Jax dotes on Brittany after her dental surgery.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S07 E14 Tom vs. Tom The Toms plan a Puerto Vallarta vacation for their friends, but Katie explodes on Sandoval when she learns they've also invited James Kennedy; Kristen and Carter share an awkward dinner on their anniversary; Lisa Vanderpump doles out wisdom.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S07 E15 Trouble in Lala-land Still grieving over her father, Lala breaks down and lashes out at James, Raquel and Billie Lee; Lisa, Sandoval and Schwartz throw all their effort into preparing TomTom for the grand opening; Jax complains about his upcoming engagement party.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S07 E16 I Don't Like the Sound of Your Voice On the day of TomTom's official opening party, Sandoval surprises Schwartz with a grand gesture; Lisa confronts Lala about her behavior at brunch; Katie sees the group's vacation to Mexico as a chance to reconnect with her busy husband.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S07 E17 Fomo in Mexico As the Mexico trip continues, Stassi unleashes her insecurities on Beau; Ariana attempts to show Lala the error of her mean girl ways; Lisa oversees TomTom's first dinner service; Jax dredges up old accusations against Kristen.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S07 E18 End of an Era In Mexico, Lala's decision to return to drinking leads to a panic attack; Tom Schwartz finds a unique way to rekindle the romance with Katie; Stassi and Beau try to repair their relationship; Lisa ponders firing a longtime staff member.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S07 E19 The Exorcism of Stassi Schroeder Tom Schwartz finds a way to make good on his financial obligation to Lisa; Stassi visits a witch to exorcise the demons threatening her relationship; Lala stages a musical performance; Jax reveals some troubling issues during couple's therapy.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S07 E20 Brittany and the Beast Scheana goes out with a model in an attempt to make Adam jealous; James accuses Lala of being insincere; Brittany's big Kentucky family descends on West Hollywood in preparation for the engagement party; Jax puts his foot in his mouth.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S07 E21 Rules of Engagement Jax and Brittany celebrate their engagement at a fairytale-themed party; Ariana confronts Lisa Vanderpump; Brittany must inform Lala that she's excluded from her wedding party; Scheana reveals she's been with another guy.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S08 E01 There Goes the Neighborhood Jax, Brittany, Schwartz, Katie, Sandoval, and Ariana move into grown-up houses; Stassi tries to repair her friendship with Kristen; Lala confides in Lisa Vanderpump; Max dates the new hostess, Dayna; Tom Sandoval skips one of Jax's wedding events.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S08 E02 Training days When new server Dayna starts dating Max, Scheana makes Dayna's life difficult; Stassi, Katie and Brittany are bothered by Kristen's ties to Carter; Jax un-invites Carter from the trip to Miami; Lala and James come to terms; Ariana opens up to Lisa.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S08 E03 Next Level Rage Texts Stassi throws a book party at TomTom but excludes Tom Sandoval from the planning; Sandoval rage texts her, leading to an epic explosion between them and forcing Tom Schwartz to pick sides; Scheana bonds with Charli over their mutual dislike of Dayna.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S08 E04 Don't Do It, Brittany When the group heads to Miami, Beau confronts Sandoval for attacking Stassi at her book signing; Ariana accuses Schwartz of not pulling his weight at TomTom; Brittany has a meltdown triggered by an unexpected reminder of Jax's infidelity.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S08 E05 Grumpy Old Men Jax and Brittany's dual bachelor/bachelorette trip charges on as Sandoval, Schwartz, Jax, and Beau plan a surprise disguise for the girls, while Stassi finds herself caught in the middle of a friendship-ending fight between Katie and Kristen.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S08 E06 Your Pride's Showing Schwartz and Sandoval prepare for TomTom's first Gay Pride celebration, but their choice to hire James as DJ backfires when he gets Raquel in trouble at SUR and Lisa thinks he's drinking again.

combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E04 Britain Under Attack (July - September 1940) After having control over mainland Europe, the German Führer sets his sights on Operation Sealion and the Battle of Britain, expecting an easy victory; he underestimates the enormity of the task and the spirit of a nation.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Battlezone WWII: Nazi Blitzkrieg - The Battle for France

combatwarchannel.us.title: Troopship Tragedy: The Sinking of the SS Mendi
combatwarchannel.us.description: To provide logistical support to WWI troops, a troopship of volunteers from the South African Native Labour Contingent is sent to France; the men never arrive; a story endures of the final hours before the volunteers drowned.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Battle of the Atlantic: Greyhound vs. Wolfpack
combatwarchannel.us.description: Serving officers, Allied navies, and merchant fleets gather for battle on a vast area of ocean control covering thousands of square miles in the Atlantic.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Broken Arrows: The Lost Bombs of the Cold War

combatwarchannel.us.title: Secrets of the Nazis
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E18 A Justice of Terror: Part One At Nuremberg, Hitler's closest allies face judgment for crimes against humanity; yet under Nazi law, these acts are legal; how Hitler reshaped the justice system, exposing the pivotal role jurists played in transforming law.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Crusade in the Pacific
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E23 Shifting Tides in the Orient The postwar Pacific witnesses nationalism and communism.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Military Legends of World War II
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E10 Medal of Honor The President of the United States, in the name of the U.S. Congress, has awarded more than 3,400 Medals of Honor to America's bravest Soldiers, Sailors, Airmen, Marines and Coast Guardsmen since the decoration's creation in 1861.

combatwarchannel.us.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days

combatwarchannel.us.title: World War II: The Price of Empire

combatwarchannel.us.title: WWII: Battles Won and Lost

combatwarchannel.us.title: Battlezone: The Vietnam War

combatwarchannel.us.title: Battlezone: The Vietnam War

combatwarchannel.us.title: Hunting Down the Nazis

crunchyroll.us.title: Robotech
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E27 Force of Arms Despite assistance from Breetai and Azonia's allied combat units, the attack from Dolza's forces devastates Earth, leading Capt. Gloval to order a life-threatening maneuver to stop the invaders once and for all.

crunchyroll.us.title: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun

crunchyroll.us.title: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun
crunchyroll.us.description: S02 E10 Balam's Lesson The instructor for the study of imaginary beasts, Balam Shichiro, can't help but touch any living creature he comes in contact with.

crunchyroll.us.title: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun
crunchyroll.us.description: S02 E11 End-of-Terminus Exams; Girls' Talk Iruma and the rest of the Misfit Class try to avoid failing and having to take supplementary classes; Clara drags Ameri off to meet with Elizabetta and Keroli for some girls' time; they start talking about relationships and things start heating up.

crunchyroll.us.title: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun
crunchyroll.us.description: S02 E12 Kalego-sensei's Home Visit On Sullivan's orders, Kalego must visit all the homes of the Misfit Class, and he tries to get it over with as soon as possible.

crunchyroll.us.title: Yuyu Hakusho
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E19 Suzaku, Leader of the Beasts Humans controlled by the Makai Insects search for Kayko; Yusuke must destroy the Makai Whistle.

crunchyroll.us.title: Yuyu Hakusho
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E20 Seven Ways to Die As battles rage, Suzaku reveals he can multiply himself into seven deadly Suzakus.

crunchyroll.us.title: Black Clover
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E02 A Young Man's Vow The grimoire that Yuno received was a legendary grimoire with a four-leaf clover; a bandit named Revchi comes to steal it, and Asta comes to Yuno's rescue.

crunchyroll.us.title: Black Clover
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E03 To the Royal Capital! Asta and Yuno spend six months training for the upcoming Magic Knights Entrance Exam; everyone seems to think Yuno is sure to pass, but worries that Asta is just wasting his time.

crunchyroll.us.title: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid S
crunchyroll.us.description: S02 E06 Uncanny Relationships (One Side Is a Dragon) Fed up with being teased by Lucoa, Shouta looks for her weak point; Takiya attempts to have Fafnir vacate his apartment during his parents' visit, but he refuses.

crunchyroll.us.title: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid
crunchyroll.us.description: S02 E07 Common Sense (It's Different For Everyone) Two suspicious figures appear in a dark alley under the cover of night; an unsettling air hangs over their secret exchange.

crunchyroll.us.title: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid S
crunchyroll.us.description: S02 E08 The World's Only (Insert Phrase You Like Here) Shouta tries to create a talisman for his dad for Father's Day; Kobayashi comes down with a cold, causing Tohru to worry about how to take care of her; Ilulu notices a doll left behind and decides to look for their owner when they don't return.

crunchyroll.us.title: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid S
crunchyroll.us.description: S02 E09 There Are Various Reasons Behind It (It's Full of Elma) Elma tries to fight for better working conditions at her and Kobayashi's job; Kanna, Riko, and Shouta ask Elma to chaperone them to go on a picnic.

crunchyroll.us.title: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid
crunchyroll.us.description: S02 E10 Kanna's Summer Break (Broadcast In Two Languages!?) After having a fight with Miss Kobayashi, Kanna runs away from home; since she doesn't want to go home she flies across the ocean to somewhere brighter where the sun's still out.

crunchyroll.us.title: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid
crunchyroll.us.description: S02 E11 Premium Seat (No Extra Charge) Miss Kobayashi's hips have seriously started hurting; she buys up a bunch of health products to try and improve it, but she hardly uses any of them; even Tohru loses her patience and tries to get her to eat tail meat, but she sadly refuses.

crunchyroll.us.title: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid
crunchyroll.us.description: S02 E12 Life is Constant Change (But It's Okay To Stop And Appreciate It) A typical morning with typical dragon girls; a priceless slice of daily life without any complaints; however, ever since Miss Kobayashi heard the tale from the Emperor of Demise, something has been slightly weighing on her.

crunchyroll.us.title: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid S
crunchyroll.us.description: Japanese Hospitality (The Attendant Is A Dragon) Chloe, Kanna's American friend, takes a trip to Tokyo; the girls head to Akihabara to play VR and try different street foods; Chloe also gets to experience the magic of a rooftop fireworks party.

crunchyroll.us.title: Scar on the Praeter
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E06 Justice With Force Left with questions about Yamato's behavior after their recent clash, Itsuki visits Yamato's brother Minato seeking answers; Kazuma comes down with a cold after days of chasing Fenrir.

crunchyroll.us.title: Scar on the Praeter
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E07 Dusk Arrives Annoyed that Yamato battled Fenrir first, Kazuma challenges Yamato to a fight; Kazuma reflects on how powerless he feels, suddenly he sees Fenrir standing before him; little does he know that Dusk is preparing to make its move.

crunchyroll.us.title: Scar on the Praeter
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E08 Dawn With Kazuma down for the count, Yamato heads to B1 to take on Dusk alone; he is overwhelmed by the sheer number of foot soldiers that stand against him.

crunchyroll.us.title: Scar on the Praeter
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E09 The Warg's Claw Marks The day after Dusk's defeat, Helios looks into the possible connection between Dusk and Fenrir; Ran and Jin discover that Fenrir has attacked Artemis Finance; they race to Azusa's office and find her on the floor.

crunchyroll.us.title: Scar on the Praeter
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E10 The Moon and the Sun Ran and Jin believe they can smoke Fenrir out after defeating Yamato and Kazuma; braving their critical injuries, Azusa and Kagami team up in a race against time to stop it all.

crunchyroll.us.title: Scar on the Praeter
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E11 Fenrir Kazuma was Fenrir all along; the tattoo possessed him three years ago; the shock of Eiji's death weakened the seal.

crunchyroll.us.title: Scar on the Praeter
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E12 The Blockade of Akatsuki Under Kouga's command, the SWAT Team moves to totally blockade the Akatsuki Special Ward; Kagami reveals that it all started from a proposal of Kouga's; Kazuma/Fenrir has plans to destroy himself after taking out everyone and everything around him.

crunchyroll.us.title: Scar on the Praeter
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E13 Hero of Akatsuki Having defeated Yamato, Fenrir attacks the SWAT Team; Artemis and the PSSS call a truce so that Artemis can go after Fenrir and the PSSS can assist the SWAT Team; Eiji confronts Fenrir to get it to give up control of Kazuma's body.

crunchyroll.us.title: Yuyu Hakusho
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E21 Yusuke's Sacrifice Yusuke must surrender his life in order for the war against the Saint Beasts to end.

crunchyroll.us.title: Yuyu Hakusho
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E22 Lamenting Beauty Yusuke, Kuwabara, and Botan plot a mission to free Yukina.

crunchyroll.us.title: Black Clover
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E04 The Magic Knights Entrance Exam Asta and Yuno head toward the colosseum in the royal capital for the Magic Knights Entrance Exam.

crunchyroll.us.title: Black Clover
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E05 The Road to the Wizard King The entrance exam comes to a close; captains decide which candidates they want for their squads.

crunchyroll.us.title: Log Horizon

crunchyroll.us.title: Log Horizon
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E08 Villain in Glasses The three biggest merchant guilds are invited to discuss how to raise money by offering a slice of the Crescent Moon pie.

crunchyroll.us.title: Log Horizon
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E09 Round Table Conference Shiro gathers all the major guilds for a round table conference to discuss the state of Akihabara; the Villain in Glasses disrupts the meeting.

crunchyroll.us.title: Log Horizon
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E10 Get It With Your Own Hands A new enemy appears that no one quite expected.

crunchyroll.us.title: Log Horizon
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E11 The Invitation from Eastal The Kingdom of Eastal invites Shiro and the Round Table to dinner; Crescent Moon holds a training camp at the beach.

crunchyroll.us.title: Log Horizon
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E12 The Forest of Lagranda The Round Table meet with delegates from Eastal and try to feel out their motives; meanwhile, Minori and her group of young adventurers take on their first dungeon.

crunchyroll.us.title: Log Horizon
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E13 Shield and Freedom Crusty uses Princess Lennessia as a shield, disguising himself among the People of the Land; Akatsuki and Shiro learn more about the NPC's intents.

crunchyroll.us.title: Log Horizon
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E14 World Fraction Shiroe and Akatsuki meet with Regan of Miral Lake and learn about the Elder Tale world; Minori tries to take charge.

crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E08 Time Is Running Out The day of live show is approaching, as is the rainy season and the boys' final exams; Mafuyu has trouble coming up with lyrics and is visited by his childhood friend, Hiiragi Kashima.

crunchyroll.us.title: given

crunchyroll.us.title: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun
crunchyroll.us.description: S02 E13 Walter Park The Misfit Class finally gets to go to Walter Park on their vacation; Kalego, Balam, and Opera go as their bodyguards and chaperones while Ameri thinks Iruma is asking her on a date and also joins in.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - Deep in the Woods

(Episode, Series, Reality, Auto) - 20261005

pickletv.us.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA) : NCPA Indiana Regional 2025 - Collegiate Team Match - Wisconsin vs. Purdue
pickletv.us.description: S2025 E17 Live from The Picklr in Noblesville, this NCPA Indiana Regional 2025 matchup features a critical battle between the University of Wisconsin-Madison and Purdue University. With eight national bids and $5,000 in prize money on the line, the stakes are high as the 16th-seeded Purdue takes on the 17th-seeded Wisconsin in a best-of-seven format.The match kicks off with Gender Doubles, where Wisconsin’s duo of Noah and Sarah Sowinski showcase dominant net play and quick hands against Purdue’s Caleb Yang and Trevor Ju. Watch for standout moments, including an incredible Ernie from Wisconsin and strategic adjustments in the Mixed Doubles games involving Colton Thielman and Elena Schlichte.

pickletv.us.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL) : WPBL 2026 - Chennai vs Hyderabad - Day 9 Tie 2
pickletv.us.description: S2 E17 Experience the electric atmosphere of the second "South Indian derby" in World Pickleball League Season 2 as the undefeated table-toppers, Chennai Super Champs, face off against the formidable Hyderabad Superstars. The drama unfolds at Mumbai's Jio World Garden with high-velocity matches, including a premier showdown between unbeaten singles stars Rika Fujiwara and Shawn Mendes. Every rally is a tactical masterclass, featuring the "beast from the East" Lee Hwang Nam in a high-stakes mixed doubles battle against Caitlin Hart and Louis Laville. From "sensational lobs" to the strategic intensity of men's singles, this tie showcases the pinnacle of professional pickleball as both teams fight for dominance on the leaderboard.

pickletv.us.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL) : WPBL 2025 - Delhi vs. Hyderabad - Day 6 Tie 2
pickletv.us.description: S2025 E12 The action from Day 6 of the World Pickleball League continues with a crucial matchup between the Delhi Dilwale and the Hyderabad Superstars.

pickletv.us.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL) : WPBL 2026 Grand Final - Chennai vs Delhi - Day 13 Tie 1
pickletv.us.description: S2 E24 The grand finale of the World Pickleball League Season 2 descends upon Mumbai’s Jio World Garden for an unforgettable clash of titans between the Chennai Super Champs and Delhi Dilwale. Witness the technical mastery of Rika Fujiwara as she faces off against Alejandra Lopez in a high-stakes women’s singles match that sets the tone for the entire championship. The intensity reaches a fever pitch during a mixed doubles "masterclass" featuring Max Mansoor and Trang Huynh, which commentators hailed as the potential "rally of the season". With the "Band of Honor" and the ultimate league trophy on the line, every strategic "Pickle Play" and nerve-wracking volley contributes to an atmosphere so electric the crowd and commentators alike are left "going berserk".
