pickletv.us.description: S1 E4 Men’s Pro Singles between Yates Johnson and William Sobek in the Pre-Medal match.

pickletv.us.title: Picklebowl 2022 : - Mixed Doubles 3
pickletv.us.description: S1 E7 Hollywood screenwriter and director Doug Ellin & pickleball pro Wes Burrows play against Pickleball pro Parris Todd & teammate Basketball Hall of Famer Rick Barry.

pickletv.us.title: DUPR Collegiate National Championship : Texas Christian vs. Texas
pickletv.us.description: S2025 E3 The battle for Texas dominance takes center stage as TCU and the University of Texas clash in the high-stakes 2025 Collegiate National Championship. Witness the racing intensity of the high-pressure "Dreambreaker" format, where rapid-fire rotations and a deafening crowd push both teams to their physical limits. This showdown highlights the elite skills of collegiate pickleball’s finest, featuring precision kitchen play and momentum-shifting timeouts as the Longhorns and Horned Frogs fight for every inch of the court. With a freestyle display of raw athleticism and school spirit, this semifinal and final match-up captures the pure essence of a historic Lone Star State rivalry.

pickletv.us.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024 : US Open 2024 – Men’s Pro Singles Backdraw Semifinal – Johnson vs Lane
pickletv.us.description: S1 E3 At the 2024 US Open Pickleball Championships, J.W. Johnson faces off against Brandon Lane in a hard-fought Men's Pro Singles Backdraw Semifinal. With powerful rallies, strategic drops, and relentless pressure, this match highlights Johnson's athleticism and Lane’s grit as they fight for a spot in the finals. Recorded live on Zing Zang Championship Court in Naples, Florida.

pickletv.us.title: DUPR Collegiate National Championship : Florida vs. Virginia
pickletv.us.description: S2025 E4 The 2025 DUPR Collegiate National Championship reaches its peak as the University of Florida and the University of Virginia face off in a high-stakes Semifinal and Final showdown. The intensity is palpable from the very first "time in," with athletes showcasing elite precision in specialized Skills challenges and explosive speed during the high-octane Racing segments. Between strategic volleys and creative Freestyle maneuvers, neither side gives an inch as the score oscillates through razor-thin margins, trading momentum with every "right back" play. This clash of titans proves why these two programs are the gold standard of collegiate pickleball, where every "point two" earned is a grueling step toward national history.

pickletv.us.title: DUPR Collegiate Super Regional : Playoffs - Wisconsin vs. Indiana
pickletv.us.description: S2025 E2 The legendary Big Ten rivalry enters the pickleball arena as the Wisconsin Badgers and Indiana Hoosiers clash in a high-stakes playoff battle at the 2025 DUPR Collegiate Ohio Super Regional. With four coveted bids to the National Championships on the line, elite athletes like Wisconsin’s Noah Havlik and Indiana’s Carter Maris engage in high-octane doubles matches defined by "majestic sorcery" and explosive power. Witness the intensity of collegiate rally scoring where every dink, drive, and around-the-post winner determines which team will punch their ticket to the season finale in April.

pickletv.us.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL) : WPBL 2026 - Chennai vs. Mumbai - Day 3 Tie 2
pickletv.us.description: S2 E6 Witness an intense showdown in Day 3, Tie 2 of the World Pickleball League Season 2 as the Chennai Super Champs face off against the home favorites, Mumbai Pickle Power, at the Jio World Garden. This episode features a mix of elite athleticism and star-studded entertainment, starting with a special appearance by legendary Bollywood choreographer Bosco Martis, who discusses the rhythmic similarities between dance and pickleball.

pickletv.us.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA) : NCPA 2026 Semifinal - University of California San Diego vs. Florida Atlantic University
pickletv.us.description: S2026 E14 The NCPA Nationals reach a fever pitch as the UC San Diego Tritons and the FAU Owls clash on the legendary Championship Court. High-energy Racing defines the pace as the "spark plug" Lisa Ritchie leads the Tritons' relentless charge against an FAU squad hungry for a major $1,000 upset bounty. Fans will witness incredible Skills on display with precision dinks and "laser beam" shots, while the Freestyle creativity of players like Gianna Jarman produces impossible angles that defy gravity. With every point feeling like a collision, the intensity builds toward a heart-stopping Sudden Death finish where one team will finally punch their ticket to the national title game.

retroplex.us.title: The Carson City Kid
retroplex.us.description: The Carson City Kid (Roy Rogers) stops stagecoaches traveling between Wild West mining towns, searching their mail sacks for letters addressed to Morgan Reynolds, the man who killed his brother. Discovering that Reynolds operates a saloon under the name Lee Jessup (Bob Steele), the Kid takes a job as the saloon's bouncer. While vying with Reynolds for the affections of singer Joby Madison (Pauline Moore), the Kid discovers a swindled miner (Noah Beery Jr.) who claims to be the Carson City Kid. (Western) - 1940

retroplex.us.title: Stage to Mesa City
retroplex.us.description: Valiant U.S. Marshal Cheyenne Davis (Al "Lash" La Rue) and his trusty deputy, Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), are on their way to aid a stagecoach owner who is mired in financial burdens. But, when they arrive and discover he's been murdered, the loyal pair are asked by Margie (Jennifer Holt), his daughter, to seek out his killers and make them pay for their vile crime. The investigation soon leads them to a sneering lawyer (Marshall Reed), who has a mysterious boss. (Western) - 1948

retroplex.us.title: Lights of Old Santa Fe
retroplex.us.description: In this musical western, Marjorie Brooks (Dale Evans) is the owner and operator of a rodeo that's an antiquated touring company on its last legs. Her business rival, Frank Madden (Richard Powers), offers to combine their operations if the lovely Marjorie will be his bride. Though she initially rebuffs his proposal, a canceled booking tips the scales and forces Marjorie to accept. But rodeo rider Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) suspects Frank is behind Marjorie's troubles and sets out to investigate. (Western) - 1944

retroplex.us.title: Robin Hood of the Pecos
retroplex.us.description: A night rider (George "Gabby" Hayes) and his singing partner (Roy Rogers) send Texas carpetbaggers packing. (Western) - 1941

retroplex.us.title: Rimfire
retroplex.us.description: An undercover Army captain (James Millican) links missing gold and murder to a gambler's (Reed Hadley) ghost. (Western) - 1949

retroplex.us.title: The Cowboy and the Senorita
retroplex.us.description: Things go from bad to worse for singing cowboy Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) and his trusty companion, Teddy Bear (Guinn "Big Boy" Williams), when, after losing their jobs at a local café, the pair are accused of having kidnapped young Chip Williams (Mary Lee) who, in reality, is merely a runaway who's been tagging along with the cowpokes. But amidst these problems, Roy and his partner decide to team up with the girl and her half-sister, Ysobel (Dale Evans), and search for some long-buried treasure. (Western) - 1944

retroplex.us.title: Under California Stars
retroplex.us.description: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom. (Western) - 1948

retroplex.us.title: Outlaws of the Plains
retroplex.us.description: An impressionable cowpoke, Fuzzy Q. Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), hears a voice claiming to be that of an old Native American, telling him the location of some hidden gold. Fuzzy does find gold, but the land has already been claimed by Nord Finner (Charles King Jr.). Finner offers to sell his claim, and Fuzzy is eager to buy. Then Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe), a friend of Fuzzy's, shows up and discovers that a gang of outlaws is behind a scheme to rob everyone in the area. (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: Shotgun
retroplex.us.description: A deputy sheriff (Sterling Hayden) seeks justice with a woman (Yvonne De Carlo), a bounty hunter (Zachary Scott) and a sawed-off shotgun. (Western) - 1955

retroplex.us.title: Romance of the West
retroplex.us.description: Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean), along with his sidekick, Ezra (Emmett Lynn), oversees the peaceful coexistence of the Native American tribes with the white settlers of Antelope Valley. The treaty that binds the two groups is threatened when some of the town leaders learn that the Native American land contains rich deposits of silver. Eager to oust the tribes and claim the silver, the town leaders try to provoke an attack that would break the treaty. It's up to Eddie to stop them in time. (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: Brother Outlaw
retroplex.us.description: A man is framed for bank robbery, prompting his brother to spring him from jail. Their search for the real culprits ends in a violent confrontation with a famed gunfighter. (Western) - 1971

retroplex.us.title: Susanna Pass
retroplex.us.description: After finding a large oil bed underneath a lake, crooked engineer Del Roberts (Douglas Fowley) plots to take control of a fish hatchery run by Russell Masters (Lucien Littlefield), brother of Roberts' accomplice, Martin Masters (Robert Emmett Keane). Acting sheriff Roy (Roy Rogers) and his deputies square off against Roberts and his henchmen, and visiting female ichthyologist "Doc" Parker (Dale Evans) is caught in the crossfire between the opposing camps. (Western) - 1949

retroplex.us.title: Bells of Coronado
retroplex.us.description: An insurance agent investigating a mine owner's death is pitted against foreign agents and uranium smugglers. (Western) - 1950

retroplex.us.title: One Man's Justice
retroplex.us.description: When the wife and daughter of Army drill sergeant John North (Brian Bosworth) are killed during an arms deal involving a crooked FBI agent named Karl Savak (Bruce Payne), John decides to take matters into his own hands, only to discover that the henchman responsible for their deaths has been put into witness protection. Now, John must enlist the help of a street-smart kid named Mikey (DeJuan Guy) to infiltrate the city's criminal underground and get his own form of revenge. (Action) - 1995

retroplex.us.title: Exit the Dragon, Enter the Tiger
retroplex.us.description: A fighter (Bruce Li) finds drug smugglers behind the death of Bruce Lee. (Action, Martial arts) - 1976

retroplex.us.title: The Silencer
retroplex.us.description: An FBI agent (Brennan Elliott) must fake his own death to team with an assassin (Michael Dudikoff) and infiltrate a terrorist group. (Action) - 1999

retroplex.us.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
retroplex.us.description: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor. (Western) - 1949

retroplex.us.title: Oklahoma Annie
retroplex.us.description: Judy Canova (Judy Canova) is a capable cowgirl and a sassy shopkeeper in her frontier town. But, once she spies the dashing new town sheriff, Dan Fraser (John Russell), Judy decides to branch out into catching crooks to garner his notice. With her daring behavior and bravery, she soon earns a deputy's badge, allowing her to spend time with her favorite lawman. But, when Dan is abducted by a band of wild outlaws, it's up to Judy to round up a posse and save the day. (Western, Comedy) - 1952

retroplex.us.title: The Unforgiven
retroplex.us.description: The Zachary family live quietly on a cattle ranch in post-Civil War Texas. A stranger (Joseph Wiseman) appears and disturbs their bucolic existence by spreading a malicious rumor that their adopted daughter, Rachel (Audrey Hepburn), is a Kiowa Native American. Soon, the Zachary brothers (Audie Murphy, Burt Lancaster) and their mother (Lillian Gish) must defend themselves from both racist whites and vengeful Kiowa. (Drama, Romance, Western) - 1960

retroplex.us.title: Stage to Mesa City
retroplex.us.description: Valiant U.S. Marshal Cheyenne Davis (Al "Lash" La Rue) and his trusty deputy, Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), are on their way to aid a stagecoach owner who is mired in financial burdens. But, when they arrive and discover he's been murdered, the loyal pair are asked by Margie (Jennifer Holt), his daughter, to seek out his killers and make them pay for their vile crime. The investigation soon leads them to a sneering lawyer (Marshall Reed), who has a mysterious boss. (Western) - 1948

retroplex.us.title: The Dawn Rider
retroplex.us.description: John Mason (John Wayne) suffers a cruel homecoming when he witnesses his father's murder as he rides into town. Incensed, he chases after the killers, but he suffers a gunshot wound that cuts his pursuit short. Alice Gordon (Marion Burns) sees to his injury, and Mason is taken by her kindness and beauty. But things turn sour when her beau, Ben (Reed Howes), becomes jealous. After Mason discovers the men who killed his father, his plan for a duel is sabotaged by Ben, who has been manipulated. (Western) - 1935

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E07 Speakeasy to Me Nicole and Caffery bring all the moody design vibes to their first speakeasy lounge for game enthusiasts Krysti and Dana; while real estate agent Natalie's compact condo listing needs staging help to spark it into a luxe and warm downtown home.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E06 A Pop of Color Kevin, Aaron, and their kids love their new home, but not the all-beige design. Without any idea of how to start, Nicole and Caffrey will bring in the color! And, Demetres needs to get a home sold that hasn't had any updates in over 30 years.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E02 An Elevated Lower Level Nicole and Caffrey design a basement getaway for Sharon, Jason and their growing tweens, creating a space where they'll actually want to hang out. They'll also help real estate pro Haaris get his bungalow listing polished up in a competitive market.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E03 Old Plan to Open Floor Plan Sarah and Mark's house needs to be brought into the 21st century so Nicole and Caffery will create a new, timeless and functional design for their family; real estate pro Karina needs help morphing a virtually staged listing into a real showstopper.

tastemadehome.us.title: Property Brothers
tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E26 Property Brothers: Jessie & Joe With twin toddlers, ex-marine Joe and Jessie outgrew their cramped Nashville condo before they moved in. And now the search is on for a farmhouse-style home where they'll have plenty of room to grow.

tastemadehome.us.title: Property Brothers
tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E13 Property Brothers: Andrew & Phil Andrew and Phil are engaged and homeless. And as they couch-surf their way around the city, these soon-to-be-weds are desperate to find a sprawling downtown home of their own.

tastemadehome.us.title: Property Brothers
tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E15 Property Brothers - Amanda & Tre Tre and Amanda have been living in a rental for nearly three years, and as the kids get bigger their temporary home is getting smaller. They're ready to find a place of their own and are determined to stay in their exclusive lakefront community.

tastemadehome.us.title: Property Brothers
tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E07 Property Brothers: Lizzy & Dave With three kids and another one on the way, Dave and Lizzy are desperate to get out of their rental and into the home of their dreams. But they've been house hunting for years already, and their due date is fast approaching.

tastemadehome.us.title: Property Brothers
tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E24 Property Brothers: Carson & Leah Super-planner Carson has been crashing at her best friend Leah's place. But it's time she found a Nashville pad of her own. Carson knows exactly what she wants, but finding a picture-perfect property that meets her high standards could prove tricky.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E01 Pub Paradise Bachelor Kyle's father Jack has helped him renovate his new home, but the backyard is still unusable. To help Kyle throw the ultimate housewarming party, Brian and Sarah build a sexy sports pub, a lounge area and a fire pit.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E02 Twins Clubhouse Sham, Ruban and their twin boys aren't using their big, boring backyard. To help this family embrace the great outdoors, Brian and Sarah build a vacation style getaway, with a beach volleyball court and a kid's clubhouse.

tastemadehome.us.title: Grand Designs
tastemadehome.us.description: S19 E01 A Concrete Bunker Kevin McCloud returns to East Sussex where concrete fanatic Adrian and wife Megan's cutting-edge concrete bunker is now complete. Is this raw, exposed concrete home really the ultimate 21st century country house?

tastemadehome.us.title: Grand Designs
tastemadehome.us.description: S19 E03 Giant Sculpture Carpenter Olaf creates an oasis for himself and partner Fritha on a small slice of land in West Sussex, squeezed by a mainline railway and a busy road. All they're left with is a very small triangle on which to build their future life together.

tastemadehome.us.title: Grand Designs
tastemadehome.us.description: S19 E07 A Modern Stonewall Mill Young Cumbrian couple Rob and Ruth take on the ruins of a 200-year-old former Blacking Mill, their bold vision to conserve as much of the original structure as possible and within the walls slot in an entirely new sharp-edged, modern building.

tastemadehome.us.title: Luxury Homes Revealed
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E05 Massive Luxurious Living Our first home is located in Hancock Park, a recently renovated 1928 estate. Then we tour an English-inspired manor in Bel Air. Afterward we travel to Australia, and then lastly we take a tour of a massive home in the Hollywood Hills.

tastemadehome.us.title: Luxury Homes Revealed
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E08 Impressively Large Estates Our first home is in Beverly Hills, California. A 10,000 square foot estate that sits above the city. A six level landmark home in New York City. To Australia to visit a home with a unique design. To Beverly Hills to see a 7,000 square foot estate.

tastemadehome.us.title: Luxury Homes Revealed
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E09 American Riviera Our first home is a sprawling and beautiful estate located in Montecito, California. Then we see a European inspired Montecito mansion. To Sydney, Australia to visit a house with water views. Then Hollywood Hills to witness an architectural gem.

tastemadehome.us.title: Luxury Homes Revealed
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E03 Incredible Private Estates Our first home is located in Palm Springs, then we get an exclusive peek inside an incredible private estate in the Hollywood Hills. Next we travel to Hampton, Australia, and then we take a tour of a resort-like home in Park City, Utah.

tastemadehome.us.title: Luxury Homes Revealed
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E01 Extraordinary Beverly Hills Today on Luxury Homes Revealed we get an exclusive tour of an extraordinary Beverly Hills mansion. On our way check out an amazing family home in Newport Coast. We travel to Merricks, Australia to visit a modern farmhouse. Then back to Beverly Hills.

tastemadehome.us.title: Luxury Homes Revealed
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E04 Breathtaking Panoramic Views Our first home is located in the Hollywood Hills, which has panoramic views of the city. Then we tour this top level Brooklyn penthouse with breathtaking views. Traveling to Armadale, Australia, and then we tour an exclusive home in West Hollywood.

tastemadehome.us.title: Alan Cumming's Paradise Homes
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E02 Good For Nature, Good For Yourself Alan is struck by the zen and minimalist interior of a mini château in the luscious French countryside and experiences an outdoor sauna in the garden of a scenic Swedish getaway.

tastemadehome.us.title: Alan Cumming's Paradise Homes
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E01 A Serene Paradise Alan surfs the waters of the Norfolk Broads where a family have created their serene paradise home, and dives into a converted magical playground in the Canadian wilderness.

tastemadehome.us.title: Alan Cumming's Paradise Homes
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E04 An Epic Landscape Alan treks up the scenic hills of Liguria to an elegant subterranean villa and explores a sleek Irish barn house combining modern and traditional styles.

tastemadehome.us.title: Alan Cumming's Paradise Homes
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E03 Hidden Hilltop Homes Alan returns to his rugged roots of the Scottish Highlands to visit an extraordinary hidden getaway and tours an eccentric space-efficient family home in Sicily.

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E10 Dreaming Big Estates We meet Michael and Kelly who are in search for a luxury home. Viviana is taking them through some the most beautiful mega mansions in Montecito and Santa Barbara, California.

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E04 An Entertainers Dream Today we meet Mish who is on the lookout for her forever home. She is looking for a home perfect for entertaining. But will Viviana be able to find her a place that fits her style?

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E08 Trading The East For A West Coast Dream Home Selena is looking to move closer to Silicon Valley from the East Coast life that she's been living. She's visiting some of the most desirable properties in Saratoga, California. Will she find her dream home?

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E12 The Ultimate Family Escape We meet John and Laura, a couple who are in search of a family escape luxury home. Viviana takes them through some of the most beautiful mega mansions in Montecito, California.

shadesofblack.us.title: The Best of Enemies
shadesofblack.us.description: The true story of the unlikely relationship between Ann Atwater, an outspoken civil rights activist, and C.P. Ellis, a local Ku Klux Klan leader. During the racially charged summer of 1971, Atwater and Ellis come together to co-chair a community summit on the desegregation of schools in Durham, N.C. The ensuing debate and battle soon lead to surprising revelations that change both of their lives forever. (Historical drama) - 2019

shadesofblack.us.title: Chaos
shadesofblack.us.description: A veteran detective is teamed with a rookie cop when they are sent to negotiate with a bunch of criminals holding a bank hostage. It transpires that a master thief has planted a computer virus that will drain funds from the bank's accounts. The detective faces a race against time to catch the thief and stop the randomly evolving computer virus, which models its behavior on the bewildering principles of chaos theory. (Action, Crime drama, Thriller) - 2005

shadesofblack.us.title: Pride
shadesofblack.us.description: In the 1970s Philadelphia, Jim Ellis, who is driven by a love of competitive swimming, fixes up an abandoned pool building with the help of a janitor named Elston. But when city officials mark the place for demolition, he fights back by founding an all-black swim team. Facing racism, violence and a hostile city official, Jim struggles to prepare his novice swimmers for the state championships. (Drama) - 2007

shadesofblack.us.title: Who's Your Caddy?
shadesofblack.us.description: Superstar rap mogul C-Note (Antwan "Big Boi" Patton) wants to join the Carolina Pines Golf & Country Club, but faces stiff opposition from the establishment's snooty members. C-Note forces the issue by purchasing the land adjacent to the golf course's 17th hole. As the club leaders search for a way to revoke his membership, C-Note realizes his family's honor and golf history are at stake, and digs in for the fight of his life. (Comedy) - 2007

shadesofblack.us.title: Bad Ass 2 : Bad Asses
shadesofblack.us.description: Frank Vega (Danny Trejo) teams up with his agoraphobic buddy Bernie Pope (Danny Glover) to clean up Los Angeles' crime-infested streets. (Action, Comedy) - 2014

shadesofblack.us.title: Mad Money
shadesofblack.us.description: After her husband loses his job, upper-crust housewife Bridget Cardigan (Diane Keaton) is forced to take a job as a janitor at the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City, Mo. Spotting a weakness in the bank's security system, Bridget convinces her two new friends Nina (Queen Latifah) and Jackie (Katie Holmes) to help her steal a fortune in worn-out bills that have been earmarked for destruction. (Comedy) - 2008

shadesofblack.us.title: Original Gangstas
shadesofblack.us.description: Successful Los Angeles football coach John Bookman returns home to Gary, IN, when his father is murdered. Discovering the town overrun with violent street gangs, John is even more horrified to learn his father was shot by a member of the Rebels, a gang John himself helped form in his youth. John teams up with Jake and Laurie, the parents of a boy who was also killed by a Rebel, to organize their neighborhood against gang violence. (Action) - 1996

shadesofblack.us.title: Monster's Ball

The affair begins just after Hank oversees the capital punishment of Leticia's husband. (Drama, Romance) - 2001

shadesofblack.us.title: Precious
shadesofblack.us.description: Pregnant by her own father for the second time, 16-year-old Claireece "Precious" Jones (Gabourey Sidibe) can neither read nor write and suffers constant abuse at the hands of her vicious mother (Mo'Nique). Precious instinctively sees a chance to turn her life around when she is offered the opportunity to transfer to an alternative school. Under the patient, firm guidance of her new teacher, Ms. Rain (Paula Patton), Precious begins the journey from oppression to self-determination. (Drama) - 2009

shadesofblack.us.title: Shottas

shadesofblack.us.title: The Pirates of Somalia

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Hawaiian Plate Lunch
tastemade.us.description: Andrew Zimmern reimagines the Hawaiian plate lunch with a hand chopped venison burger topped with homemade gravy and a fried egg, jumbo grilled shrimp, a humble macaroni salad and a heaping scoop of white rice. (Cooking) - 2024-03-26

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Yakitori-Style Skewers and Pheasant Flatbread
tastemade.us.description: Andrew butchers a whole pheasant to make yakitori-style skewers and a homemade flatbread, cucumber salad and a mango chutney. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - The King of Open-Fire Paella
tastemade.us.description: Andrew Zimmern showcases quail two ways: classic Southern fried quail with lemon-basil aioli, and as an elevated topping for a traditional open-fire paella, complete with crispy socarrat. He proves this small bird makes an extraordinary dinner. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Elk Tenderloin Tostadas and Grilled Rack of Ribs
tastemade.us.description: Andrew Zimmern highlights lean elk, first crafting classic Mexican tostadas with grilled tenderloin, avocado, and homemade salsa macha. Then, he grills a whole rack of elk, serving it with creamy colcannon, tarragon emulsion, and rosemary charcoal. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Braised Pigeon with Homemade Herb Gnocchi
tastemade.us.description: Chef Andrew Zimmern cooks braised squab with olives and vinegar, a perfect meal for a fall evening. (Cooking) - 2023-09-11

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - How to Cook a Whole Pig at Home
tastemade.us.description: Andrew tackles suckling pig with two recipes-his take on a three-cup braise with soy, rice wine, and sesame oil, served with plancha fried rice, and a whole pig roasted over open fire and pulled for Philly-style pork sandwiches with broccoli rabe. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Goat Curry with Rice Pilaf and Carmelized Onions
tastemade.us.description: Chef Andrew butchers a whole goat, using the leg and backstrap for a braised curry. (Cooking) - 2023-09-12

tastemade.us.description: Andrew builds a massive Chicago-style fried beef sandwich with peppers, onions and molten cheese before tackling true snout-to-tail cooking: a whole simmered cow head transformed into crispy tacos de cabeza with two salsas. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.description: Andrew butchers a whole pheasant to make yakitori-style skewers and a homemade flatbread, cucumber salad and a mango chutney. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out - The Only Pulled Pork Recipe You'll Ever Need
tastemade.us.description: Kevin and Noah are smoking up some BBQ Pulled Pork Sandwiches with Coleslaw; frying up a skillet of Creole Cabbage; and charcoal-grilling some Steak Sandwiches with Chimichurri Mayo. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out - The Secret to World-Class Texas Brisket
tastemade.us.description: Kevin and Noah are making brisket 3 ways! They're pit-smoking a classic Texas brisket; showing you how to gussy up a pot of Brisket Baked Beans; and making a charcoal-grilled Vietnamese Brisket Noodle Bowl with all the fixings. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out - Beef Shank is the New Brisket
tastemade.us.description: Kevin and Noah are smoking a humungous Thor's Hammer; cooking up some Catfish & Eggs for breakfast; making a Grilled Salsa Verde; and putting on a pot of Mezcal Charro Beans. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out - These Smoked Turkey Legs are better than the State Fair
tastemade.us.description: Kevin and Noah smoke up some State Fair Turkey Legs; fry some skillet Chorizo & Eggs; smoke-and-fry some Buffalo Rib Tips; and cook up some Sriracha and Garlic-Butter Grilled Shrimp. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Fire Masters - Sticks and Stones…but please no bones!
tastemade.us.description: The judges have a bone to pick with the chefs in the Signature Round. No stone is left unturned as the chefs battle it out in the Crossfire Round. The Feast of Fire serves up some flame-kissed New Orleans food. (Reality, Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Fire Masters - No Charred Feelings
tastemade.us.description: Tension flares up quickly in the Wildfire Round. Chefs must take the Crossfire Round with a grain of salt, and the final round is all about celebrating the Cape. (Reality, Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Fire Masters - No Grits, No Glory
tastemade.us.description: In the Wildfire Round, the chefs try not to crack under pressure. It's Fight or Flight in the Crossfire Round, and in the Feast of Fire, the judges are treated to some Southern Hospitality. (Reality, Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver's Ultimate BBQ - Grilled Fish Tacos and a Veggie Pancake
tastemade.us.description: For the ultimate BBQ experience, Jamie cooks a Butterflied Leg of Lamb, his Spiced Chicken Kebabs and creamy butter sauce perfect for a party, followed by Grilled Fish Tacos and Jamie's Tear 'n' Share Veggie Pancake ready to feed a crowd. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver's Ultimate BBQ - Grilled Steak Salad and Italian-style Lamb Chops
tastemade.us.description: Jamie shares his perfect Steak & Chargrilled Salad, a Chicken Caesar Salad with an upgrade on the bars, Italia-inspired Sizzling Lamb Lollipops and his delicious Whole Barbecue Fish & Ratatouille to upgrade your grill skills! (Cooking) - 2026-09-01

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver's Ultimate BBQ - Sesame Chicken Burger and Surf & Turf Mixed Grill
tastemade.us.description: Jamie takes outdoor cooking to new heights with his Ultimate Barbecue Breakfast, a smoke-kissed Sesame Chicken Burger, his Veggie Barbecue Mezze offering an epic spread; and his Surf & Turf Mixed Grill is a perfect party crowd-pleaser! (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - The Most Underrated Game Bird
tastemade.us.description: Goose, one of Andrew's favorite game birds, is prepared two ways: a French onion soup-style grilled breast sandwich with caramelized onions and melted cheese, and a whole bird, cured, roasted on a beer can, and served with an apple-fennel salad. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Game Day Fried Squab
tastemade.us.description: Andrew gives squab the game-day treatment with two bold recipes: crispy Buffalo-style fried squab with blue cheese and ranch, and red chile grilled squab taquitos with green tomatillo salsa, cotija and crema. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - The Ultimate Elk Tailgate
tastemade.us.description: It's an elk tailgate over live fire. Andrew makes chorizo-spiced elk meatballs with queso fundido and red chile salsa, then cooks hay-smoked elk chops with charred alliums and black garlic-juniper butter. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - The Best Fish You're Not Eating
tastemade.us.description: Andrew takes on "little fish, big fish," cooking grilled whole small fish over Japanese charcoal with sesame spinach, and a larger fish in a bold puttanesca-style dish. Simple techniques, big flavor, and a case for eating lower on the food chain. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Game Day Chicago-Style Beef Sandwich
tastemade.us.description: Andrew builds a massive Chicago-style fried beef sandwich with peppers, onions and molten cheese before tackling true snout-to-tail cooking: a whole simmered cow head transformed into crispy tacos de cabeza with two salsas. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Grilled Yellowtail Collars & Filets with Miso Sauce
tastemade.us.description: Andrew cooks yellowtail two ways: grilled collars with a sweet, savory Filipino-inspired adobo sauce, and grilled filets with miso sauce, shiso butter, and charred vegetables. A lesson in using the whole fish and getting more from every cut. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: All Up In My Grill - Luxe Lobster & Prime Rib
tastemade.us.description: Chef Dale Talde pulls out all the stops for this daddy-sized dinner. He grills up prime rib with herb & horseradish crust, lobster & chili sauce American, charred green beans with garlic tahini, and cheddar-stuffed parker house rolls. (Cooking) - 2023-06-14

tastemade.us.title: All Up In My Grill - Perfectly Prepared Steaks
tastemade.us.description: Big Daddy Dale Talde shows you how to marinate, prep, & grill up the biggest and best steaks out there. From a Hanger Steak with Salsa Verde to a Ribeye with Ginger Chili Relish, and tops it all off with the father of all steaks… The Porterhouse. (Cooking) - 2022-06-16

tastemade.us.title: All Up In My Grill - Tempting Tasty Tacos
tastemade.us.description: It's always taco night at Chef Dale's house! He turns up the heat with grilled salmon tacos with salsa verde & cauliflower escabeche, duck al pastor tacos with habanero pineapple salsa, & a smoky mushroom queso taco with truffle mole negro. (Cooking) - 2023-08-10

tastemade.us.title: All Up In My Grill - A Festive & Flavorful Christmas in July
tastemade.us.description: Chef Dale Talde grills smoked ham and pineapple praline sliders, sweet potatoes with soy maple bacon, eggplant with labneh and cranberries, a holiday mezze plate and a grilled coquito cocktail. (Cooking) - 2023-07-26

tastemade.us.title: All Up In My Grill - Beer Brats & BBQ Ribs
tastemade.us.description: Chef Dale Talde grills up summer favorites perfect for any backyard BBQ. Cheddar beer brats in a pretzel bun, BBQ lamb ribs with Chinese mustard sauce, watermelon lime soju punch, & warm donuts with grilled strawberries & whipped cream for dessert. (Cooking) - 2023-05-24

tastemade.us.title: All Up In My Grill - Pizzapalooza
tastemade.us.description: Chef Dale Talde is throwin' down a pizza spread like never before with his Chicago-style tavern pie with sausage & onion, a grilled pizza pocket with pepperoni & cheese, chicken wings a la pizzaiola, and a zesty grilled Caesar salad to finish it off. (Cooking) - 2023-08-31

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - The Most Underrated Game Bird

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Exploring The 'Wet Market' Of Nha Trang
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke hops on the train in Ga Thap Cham, and finds himself in Nha Trang—a region of Vietnam with a similar vibe to the French Riviera! Luke hand-catches seafood, looks for some fresh durian fruit, and visits a barramundi farm to harvest sea grapes! (Cooking) - 2020-02-24

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Fiery Chili Sauce in Hoi An
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke is in the town of Hội An. He visits a family who has been making chili sauce for 5 generations, stops by the Historic Japanese Covered Bridge built in 1719, and meets a 4th generation blacksmith who is creating knives from bombshells. (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-03

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Seafood With A Bang, Here In Da Nang
tastemadetravel.us.description: On this stop of his Vietnam journey, Luke visits the bustling seaside city of Da Nang. Join him as he visits the spectacular Dragon Bridge, looks up some succulent shrimp on the beach, and stumbles upon a tiny fishing village packed with restaurants. (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-10

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Savoury Vietnamese Pancakes in Huė
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke visits Huế - famous for its heritage and cuisine - and Con Hen Village to learn a technique for de-shelling baby clams, searches for best bowl of spicy beef noodle soup, and stops by a business where they make turmeric vermicelli noodle salad! (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-17

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Tasty Ant Eggs in Ninh Binh
tastemadetravel.us.description: After a long trip from Hue, Luke finally gets some rest in the scenic Ninh Bihn. Tag along as Luke meets with a local rice farmer, takes a canoe out for some crab hunting, and ventures deep into the jungle in search of a local delicacy- red ant eggs! (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-24

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Searching For The Banh Da Noodle in Hai Phong
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke is in northern Vietnam- Hai Phong! This is the birthplace of his partner Lynne. Join Luke as he meets some of Lynne's family for the first time, and tries the delicious Banh Da Noodle- a tasty dish that Hai Phong is renowned for! (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-31

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Delicious Bun Cha in Hanoi
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke's penultimate stop on his train journey is Hanoi. Follow Luke on his hunt for an iconic Hanoi dish, Bun Cha. Luke takes a ride on the Reunification Express railway, and visits the famous Hoan Kiem Lake for some delicious magenta sticky rice. (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-04-07

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Sipping Gin in Sapa
tastemadetravel.us.description: Nearing the end of his Vietnamese journey, Luke stops in Sapa, a hilltop region that he remembers from his travels fifteen years ago. Join Luke as he rekindles a friendship from his previous visit and learns about a local dish of dried buffalo. (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-04-14

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Making Couscous in Tunisia
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie explores Tunisia to meet traditional couscous makers, eat delicious street food, and get invited to cook with local chefs on a beach. Inspired by everything he sees, Jamie cooks crispy prawn parcels and a chicken and merguez sausage stew. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Traditional Greek Cuisine
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie heads to Greece, to the island of Skopelos, starting on the mainland in Thessaloniki. Inspired by meze plates and traditional island cuisine he cooks up a smoky aubergine flatbread and a lemony chargrilled chicken with tzatziki and rice. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Inspirational Spanish Tapas
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie's soaking up inspiration in Spain with tapas, flavor-charged rice dishes, and spectacular seafood. He cooks a stunning pork chop with peppers and aioli and a surf and turf skewer of prawns, mushrooms, and local ham. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Stunning Seafood of Marseille
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie heads to Marseille in the south of France. Inspired by their stunning seafood, the traditional flavors of Provence, and the multicultural dishes being served up there, he cooks up a steak with a twist and a sublime courgette and olive tart. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Tuscan Farmhouse Classics
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie is taking spaghetti bolognese to the next level and re-creating a mind-blowing Jewish-Italian recipe. There's also beef stew with pappardelle. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Making Pizza in Naples
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie visits the pizza capital of Italy to learn recipes from the locals and tries acquapazza, fish poached in crazy water. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's India - Exploring the Night Markets of Bangalore
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke heads to the city of Bangalore in southern India; he visits MTR, one of the oldest coffee houses in the city; he learns how to make idli; he meets up with a friend to explore the night markets. (Cooking, Travel) - 2023-11-21

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's India - The Coffee Culture of Coimbatore
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke learns about Kongunadu cuisine in Coimbatore, partners with a family in Thrissur to create an authentic delicacy and learns about India's rich coffee culture. (Cooking, Travel) - 2023-11-21

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's India - Discovering the Mystical Kerala Backwaters
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke visits the port city of Kochi, Kerala, where he checks out the iconic Chinese fishing nets, does laundry the old-fashioned way and cooks a famous dish. He leaves the city to witness the state's backwaters and local fishing techniques. (Cooking, Travel) - 2023-11-28

tastemadetravel.us.title: Extraordinary Places to Eat - Searching for the Best Pizza in Rome, Italy
tastemadetravel.us.description: Chef Giorgio Locatelli takes Fred to Rome in search of the city's most exciting eats. Sublime pasta, fluffy gnocchi and the world's best pizza all delicious but affordable. (Travel, Cooking, Documentary) - 2024-02-07

tastemadetravel.us.title: Extraordinary Places to Eat - The Master Pasta Maker of Puglia, Italy
tastemadetravel.us.description: TV and radio host Dermot O'Leary takes Fred Sirieix to Puglia in Italy's deep South to his favourite restaurants showcasing simple but sublime cucina povera or poor man's cooking. (Travel, Cooking, Documentary) - 2024-01-23

tastemadetravel.us.title: Extraordinary Places to Eat - The Floating Restaurant of Devon, United Kingdom
tastemadetravel.us.description: Fred travels to South Devon with chef and restaurateur Angela Hartnett. From Angela's all-time favourite restaurant in Dartmouth to an incredible floating café on the River Exe. (Travel, Cooking, Documentary) - 2024-02-14

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Secret Family Recipies in Ho Chi Minh
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke searches to find Ho Chi Minh's old markets before they disappear due to District 1's rapid development. Join Luke as he gathers fresh ingredients from a local market, tries some traditional delicacies, and follows his sweet tooth to Marou. (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-02-04

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Vietnamese Pizza in Dalat
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke's next stop is the destination of Dalat. Follow Luke as he visits the Art Deco Dalat Train Station, experiences the French influence of the region with a father and son chef duo, and discovers why Dalat is known as the "Land of Eternal Spring"! (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-02-17

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Exploring The 'Wet Market' Of Nha Trang
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke hops on the train in Ga Thap Cham, and finds himself in Nha Trang—a region of Vietnam with a similar vibe to the French Riviera! Luke hand-catches seafood, looks for some fresh durian fruit, and visits a barramundi farm to harvest sea grapes! (Cooking) - 2020-02-24

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Getting to the Roots
tastemadetravel.us.description: The chefs and owners of Xokol restaurant in Guadalajara reconnect with their roots; chef Marin creates a drink and dessert inspired by his grandmother; chef Francisco Migoya makes a dessert. (Cooking) - 2021-10-27

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Heart of Tequila
tastemadetravel.us.description: Exploring the town of Tequila, Jalisco; the history of making tequila and a close up look at the process from the agave fields to the tasting table. (Cooking) - 2021-11-03

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Double Vallarta
tastemadetravel.us.description: Chef Thierry Blouet offers a tour of Puerto Vallarta's street food; La Docena restaurant; the ins and outs of one of Nuevo Vallarta's biggest resort destinations. (Cooking) - 2021-11-10

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Sisters, Stew, and Sass
tastemadetravel.us.description: Roasted tomatoes rice with cumin and oregano; chicken livers with chipotle caramelized onions; avocado and panela cheese salad. (Cooking) - 2022-09-16

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - A Mayan League of Their Own
tastemadetravel.us.description: Amazonas softball team; sweet potato and meat salpicon; pepita, egg and chaya tamales; roasted tomato and habanero salsa. (Cooking) - 2023-11-17

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Yucatán Meats
tastemadetravel.us.description: Temozón is the birthplace of Yucatán's signature smoked meat Carne Ahumada and everyone in town claims to have a relative who invented it. Pati strolls around town to try different versions of Carne Ahumada. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Los Mariachis
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati learns about the history, the instruments, and the meaning behind Mariachi music. Pati makes carne en su jugo, tres chiles guacamole, and masa berry shortcake. (Cooking) - 2024-03-07

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Welcome to Guadalajara
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati explores the culinary highlights of Jalisco's capital city, Guadalajara. She starts at a street cart to taste the city's most iconic sandwich, tortas ahogadas. Then, she meets one of the city's best chefs, Fabian Delgado. (Cooking) - 2024-02-29

waypointtv.us.title: Into the Blue : Stock Island Grocery Run
waypointtv.us.description: S14 E09 Captains Scott and Steve take a long run into the Gulf from Stock Island to load their coolers with cobia and huge yellowtail snapper.

waypointtv.us.title: Into the Blue : Kingfishing West of Key West
waypointtv.us.description: S14 E10 Captains Scott and Steve sail west of Key West to battle with big kingfish and end up with plenty of meat for the smoker.

waypointtv.us.title: Into the Blue : Key West Yellowtail and Cero on Fly
waypointtv.us.description: S14 E11 Captains Steve Rodger and Scott Walker prove themselves to be among the top charter boat and tournament captains in offshore fishing; follow their journey to fishing destinations as they share the techniques that have driven their success.

waypointtv.us.title: Winchester Life : Lonestar Legends
waypointtv.us.description: S03 E05 Highlighting the stories and people who have made the shooting sports and hunting lifestyle a part of their lives.

waypointtv.us.title: Sail Kings : Tackle Center
waypointtv.us.description: S02 E08 Capt. Jared travels to Venice, Louisiana, where the Mississippi River meets the Gulf, joining Capt. Garrett George and Capt. Jesse LeBoeuf for an action-packed offshore adventure in pursuit of Redfish and Tuna.

waypointtv.us.title: Fox Hollow Outdoors
waypointtv.us.description: Double or Nothin' Michael and Larken head to South Texas in search of trophy-sized trout; along the way, they make a pit stop to gear up and custom-build a Texas wading rod.

waypointtv.us.title: Fox Hollow Outdoors
waypointtv.us.description: The Chikee Larkin and Michael set out on a Florida Man adventure in Part 1 of this 2-part series; join them in the Florida Keys and Everglades for an experience that few get to experience.

waypointtv.us.title: Fox Hollow Outdoors
waypointtv.us.description: Lucky Tuna Michael and Larken end their trip to Florida with an epic day of offshore fishing with Captain Chris Trosset.

waypointtv.us.description: New Zealand Andy and his son, Logan, visit the country of New Zealand; they explore vineyards, helicopter hunts and more.

waypointtv.us.title: Wildbound by Forloh
waypointtv.us.description: Wildbound -- Alaska Andy and his friend Scotty take on Kodiak Island, Alaska for an adventure of salmon fishing and hunting black-tailed deer.

waypointtv.us.title: Wildbound by Forloh
waypointtv.us.description: Wildbound - Alabama Andy goes back to his home farm in Alabama for deer and quail hunting; he makes dishes with his former "Master Chef" contestant, Alex.

waypointtv.us.title: Wildbound by Forloh
waypointtv.us.description: Wildbound -- UK Part 1 Andy starts his road trip around the United Kingdom in the Cotswolds where he sets out to hunt and taste the venison that Michelin star chef Mark Robinson has to offer.

waypointtv.us.description: S03 E01 Captain Brandon visits Quails Landing Plantation in South Georgia and his buddy Steven Redrick for some outdoor activities.

waypointtv.us.title: Local Lines : One - Two Punch
waypointtv.us.description: S03 E02 Brandon fishes with Robbie Crosnoe on Lake Henderson.

waypointtv.us.title: Local Lines : Mahi Madness
waypointtv.us.description: S03 E03 Capt. Brandon Branch, Steve Grant and Kelly Player leave Jacksonville, FL for the Gulf Stream to get into some Mahi.

waypointtv.us.title: Local Lines : Seabass
waypointtv.us.description: Captain Brandon Branch of Crystal River, Florida walks through his local area, as well as some new areas Brandon has never fished before.

waypointtv.us.title: Hard Truths Of Conservation : 100 Lions
waypointtv.us.description: In the heart of the Zambezi Delta, a team of conservationists have overseen one of the largest range expansions of African lions in modern times. From a reintroduction of 24 lions in 2018, today the population is more than a hundred.

waypointtv.us.title: Hard Truths Of Conservation : Elephant in the Room
waypointtv.us.description: What happens to the elephants when an area reaches carrying capacity? Dan Cabela investigates the growing problem, visiting Zimbabwe, Namibia and Angola to explore the future of elephant conservation.

waypointtv.us.title: The Direction : Life Is A Highway
waypointtv.us.description: We reflect on a tragic and sad memory in our lives as we remember a dear childhood friend of my son Nick, Nathan Wimsatt. Our families have been close for man years and shared a lot of time around the soccer field, vacations, fishing trips, and more.

waypointtv.us.title: The Direction : Worship, Music, and Bassin'
waypointtv.us.description: We're joined by Worship Leader, Rob Key. A musical talent that's chased the country music dream, but found his calling as worship leader at Taylorsville Community Church; Rob's love for serving the Lord is his top priority, but he also likes fishing.

waypointtv.us.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoors : The Final Voyage
waypointtv.us.description: Tournament angler Blair Wiggins of "Addictive Fishing" continues his fishing adventures but also shares his love of everything outdoors, including hunting, cooking, beekeeping and more.

waypointtv.us.title: Flats Class : The Tide Master, Part 1
waypointtv.us.description: CA and Brian Vaughn plan out an epic fishing trip fishing the flood tides of Hilton Head, S.C.

waypointtv.us.title: Into the Blue : Trolling Bonitas out of Key West
waypointtv.us.description: S14 E11 Captains Scott and Steve catch bonito for bait, slow-trolling them around wrecks to lure wahoo and kingfish.

waypointtv.us.title: Into the Blue : Welcome to Galveston
waypointtv.us.description: S13 E01 Capt. Scott Walker and Capt. Steve Rodger visit Galveston, Texas, and stay at the iconic Tremont House; the two get shown around the waters off the coast by local guide Capt. Brian Wilson.

waypointtv.us.title: Into the Blue : Galveston Red Snapper
waypointtv.us.description: S13 E03 Capt. Scott Walker and Capt. Steve Rodger continue their Galveston adventure with local guide Capt. Brian Wilson; this time they're hunting big red snapper off the coast.

waypointtv.us.title: Into the Blue : Triple Tail in the Florida Bay
waypointtv.us.description: S13 E02 Taking off from the Hawks Cay Resort, Capt. Scott Walker and Capt. Steve Rodger head out into the Florida Bay to target triple tails; these bulky fish are built like tanks and fight hard.

waypointtv.us.title: Into the Blue : Rough Day at the Hump
waypointtv.us.description: S13 E04 High winds and big seas can't stop Capt. Scott Walker and Capt. Steve Rodger from targeting tuna at the West Hump of the coast of the Florida Keys.

waypointtv.us.title: Into the Blue : Sailfish Save the Day
waypointtv.us.description: S13 E06 Being consistently productive on the water means knowing how to adapt to conditions; Capt. Scott Walker and Capt. Steve Rodger switch it up and fish shallow for sailfish.

waypointtv.us.title: Reel Animals
waypointtv.us.description: Anything and Everything Young Captain Reed Tudor hosts Captain Mike in Duck Key, FL and puts him on Micro Tarpon, Redfish and Goliath Grouper.

waypointtv.us.title: Beyond the Surface : Young Gun
waypointtv.us.description: Capt. Danny Allen shares his adventures and tips while he visits Florida's historical fishing destinations.

waypointtv.us.title: Operation Healing Heroes : Eddie Jaramillo
waypointtv.us.description: S04 E09 U.S. Marine Corps veteran Eddie Jaramillo speaks about his life of continued service as he and host Jay Garstecki get tattoos from one of the country's premier tattoo artists.

waypointtv.us.title: The Raven Project : Bow Camp 2025 at The Dirty Bird

waypointtv.us.title: The Raven Project : The Raven Project - Summer Prep And Randy Raven Bow Kill
waypointtv.us.description: Randy is at the Raven spraying some clover plots, trimming limbs, checking tree stand straps, and just doing some overall summertime maintenance. Fast-forward to fall and Randy is able to catch up with one of his top hit list bucks on the Raven.

waypointtv.us.title: The Raven Project : The Raven Project - Bow Camp 2025 at The Dirty Bird Part 2
waypointtv.us.description: Nate catches up with the Oklahoma buck that he had the close call with, and Cody is able to close the chapter with a buck he has been after for a few seasons.

waypointtv.us.title: The Raven Project : Turkey Camp at the Dirty Bird
waypointtv.us.description: The story of a true old school deer camp meeting new world management practices to take a raw piece of hunting land and develop it into whitetail Mecca.

truehistory.us.title: The Life and Work of Mark Twain - Innocents Abroad, I-Going East
truehistory.us.description: Henry Ward Beecher organizes Twain's trip East as a pilgrimage to pay obeisance to the founding monuments of Western culture; how Twain turns the tables; whether Twain is psychologically preparing America for its role as a world power. (Educational) - 2002-07-16

truehistory.us.title: The Life and Work of Mark Twain - Innocents Abroad, II-Traveling to Unlearn
truehistory.us.description: Twain's goal in "Innocents Abroad" is to teach his readers to see the Old World with their own eyes, asking what of value can remain after everything is mocked into submission when Twain trains his wit on the holy sites of the Bible. (Educational) - 2002-07-16

truehistory.us.title: The Life and Work of Mark Twain - Roughing It-Going West
truehistory.us.description: Twain mines his own past as a prospector and turns it into comic frontier fiction in "Roughing It"; the work also marks Twain's first prominent use of American vernacular language; his intimation that it deserves a place in American literature. (Educational) - 2002-07-16

truehistory.us.title: The Life and Work of Mark Twain - The Lecture Tours
truehistory.us.description: Despite the rigors of touring and the limitations imposed by his audiences' tastes, Twain comes to love the thrill of live lecturing; he skillfully blends the serious academic content that audiences demand with his own trademark sardonic wit. (Educational) - 2002-07-16

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S18 E01 Sliding Barn Door; Dry Well Nathan installs a sliding barn door in an open-concept loft apartment; Tom compares different types of roofing materials; Ross explains the culprit behind damaged solar panels; Mark installs a dry well for a homeowner with drainage issues.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S18 E02 Nursery Paint; Record Stand Mauro paints a baby's nursery using zero VOC paint; Richard tests out a new dryer that uses a heat pump to dry the clothes; Tom and Kevin build a record player stand out of oak plywood.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S18 E03 Radiator; Fireplace Veneer Planting a small herb garden with a cocktail theme; a homeowner's radiator sprung away from the pipe when he tried to replace the valve, so Richard heads to his house to help him reconnect it; Mark replaces a homeowner's sloppy fireplace surround.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S18 E04 Ductless Humidifier; Planters Tom explains the uses of different types of screws; Richard travels to Park City, Utah to install a whole house ductless humidifier; Ross and Richard discuss changes to electric bill payment structures; Jenn installs a planter for a homeowner.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S18 E05 Built-in; Dining Room Light Tom repairs an old dining room built-in with hand tools and a bar of soap; the team shares more home inspection nightmares; Heath Eastman makes his first house call to install a chandelier in a homeowner's dining room.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S18 E06 Women's Repair Class; Garden Tom checks out a women-only DIY class; Jenn helps a homeowner select, place, and install plants for her terraced garden; the ways homeowners and contractors should communicate to set appropriate expectations for home improvement projects.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S18 E07 Switch; Affordable Geothermal Replacing a standard toggle switch with a reproduction antique push button switch to match the rest of the house; in Albany, N.Y., Ross explores ways to make drilling for and installing geothermal heat pumps more affordable for average homeowners.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S18 E08 Polybutylene; Squeaky Door Ross and Richard discuss indoor air quality; Richard helps a homeowner replace her polybutylene piping with conventional PEX; home inspection nightmares; selecting drop cloths; Tom explains different methods for silencing a squeaky door.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S36 E01 Charlestown 2014: 35 Years of This Old House An 1850s-era Greek Revival brick rowhouse in historic Charlestown, MA; the spaces that will be getting minimal work: an existing guest room, guest bath, and living room; a plan for the basement; Norm and Tom test for lead paint before digging begins.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S36 E02 Charlestown 2014: Brick Rowhouse Blues Tom builds a structural wall to solve bowing in the roof; on the third floor, Norm shows Kevin how the roof has been under-structured since it was built; Tom helps get LVLs tucked into the brick sidewalls and fastened in place.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S36 E03 Charlestown 2014: A Bridge to Charlestown Richard shows the Zakim Bridge with the structural engineer on the project; modifying the house's old chimney for new gas fireplace units; the framing progress; options for rebuilding the retaining walls; installing an interlocking concrete system.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S36 E06 Charlestown 2014: Kitchens and Baths Greek Revival-style front door; Angela's cabinets arrive; Tom and Kevin install new wainscoting; Norm learns about Charlestown's ancient past; a feature wall insert is added in the master shower; Kevin and Tom install a small section of copper roof.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

classica.us.title: Jaroussky singt Bach & Telemann
classica.us.description: Philippe Jaroussky ist der Superstar der hohen Töne. Auf dem Höhepunkt seiner Karriere gastierte er bereits auf fast allen Bühnen der Welt. Für die Konzertsaison 2015/16 hat er sich einen langersehnten Traum erfüllt: Mit Unterstützung des herausragenden Freiburger Barockorchesters widmet er sich den Kantaten Bachs und Telemanns. Die Musikdokumentation begleitet Jaroussky zu den CD-Aufnahmen in Freiburg und gibt Einblicke in die präzise Arbeit des Künstlers. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2017-04-09

classica.us.title: Rachmaninow - Sonate für Cello, Op. 19
classica.us.description: Silvia Chiesa und Maurizio Baglini präsentieren ein bezauberndes Konzert mit Werken von Busoni, Liszt, Chopin und Rachmaninow. Diese Aufführung wurde am 4. November 2024 im Sala Verdi des Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi in Mailand aufgenommen. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2025-10-04

classica.us.title: Patmos - Ein musikalischer Dokumentarfilm
classica.us.description: Jeden Sommer findet auf der griechischen Insel Patmos das Patmos Musikfestival statt, ein Ereignis, das sowohl ein Kammer- als auch ein Sakralmusikfestival umfasst. Dieser Film dokumentiert die Ausgabe von 2024 und zeigt Auftritte von renommierten Solisten und Ensembles aus aller Welt. Zum Programm gehört unter anderem der künstlerische Leiter des Festivals und Pianist Roberto Prosseda. In Interviews teilen mehrere Künstler ihre Erfahrungen mit diesem Festival und die Atmosphäre der Insel. (Special, Documentary, Musical) - 2026-01-03

classica.us.title: Schostakowitsch - Concertino für zwei Klaviere
classica.us.description: Anlässlich ihres 80. Geburtstags widmet sich die argentinische Pianistin Martha Argerich dem Repertoire für Klavier und Violine in diesem wunderbaren Konzert, das im Château de Chantilly in Frankreich aufgezeichnet wurde. (Special, Music) - 2025-05-31

classica.us.title: Mahler - Symphonie Nr. 10
classica.us.description: Mahlers 10. Symphonie ist ein unvollendetes Werk, das der Komponist bei seinem Tod hinterließ und das seine letzte emotionale Reise von Qual und Herzschmerz zu einer vorbehaltlosen Akzeptanz des Lebens und der menschlichen Liebe darstellt. (Special) - 2026-04-18

classica.us.title: In der Probe: - Mariss Jansons
classica.us.description: Mariss Jansons probt mit dem Oslo Philharmonischen Orchester die kraftvolle Suite aus Béla Bartóks Pantomimenballett "Der wunderbare Mandarin", gefolgt von einer Aufführung des gleichen Stücks aus dem Konzerthaus von Oslo. (Music) - 2000-04-23

classica.us.title: Grieg - Klavierkonzert in a-Moll, Op. 16
classica.us.description: Dirigent Jan Latham-Koenig leitet das Flanders Symphony Orchestra mit einer Aufführung von Edvard Griegs Klavierkonzert in a-Moll, Op. 16. Diese Aufführung wurde am 21. April 2016 im Concertgebouw Brügge, Belgien, aufgezeichnet. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2025-01-03

classica.us.title: Beethoven - 1. Klavierkonzert, Op. 15
classica.us.description: Lars Vogt ist Solist in einer Aufführung von Beethovens erstem Klavierkonzert. Das Orchestre de Paris wird von Herbert Blomstedt dirigiert. Die Aufnahme entstand 2013 im Salle Pleyel in Paris. (Music) - 2020-03-22

classica.us.title: Bach - 3. Sonate für Violin (BWV 1005)
classica.us.description: Isabelle Faust spielt zwei unglaubliche Solowerke für Violine von J. S. Bach: Partita Nr. 2 in d-Moll BWV 1004 und Sonate Nr. 3 in C-Dur BWV 1005. Beide Werke sind Teil der bekannten Sonaten und Solo-Partiten für Violine des Komponisten. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2023-05-31

classica.us.title: Misha Fomin at the Concertgebouw 2018
classica.us.description: Der russische Starpianist Michail Fomin tritt im Concertgebouw in Amsterdam auf. Auf dem Programm stehen Beethovens 8. Klaviersonate "Pathétique", seine Mondscheinsonate, Op. 27, Nr. 2, sowie Tschaikowskis "Vier Jahreszeiten", Op. 37b. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2020-01-04

classica.us.title: Debussy, La Mer
classica.us.description: Claude Debussys sinfonische Skizzen für Orchester, allgemein bekannt unter dem Namen "La Mer", beschwören das Meer in seiner vielfältigen Gestalt herauf. Dieses Konzert in der Kölner Philharmonie wird vom Chicago Symphony Orchestra unter der Leitung von Daniel Barenboim gespielt. (Special, Music, Classical, Opera) - 2018-05-11

classica.us.title: Delibes, Coppélia
classica.us.description: Aus der Opéra Royal du Château de Versailles: "Coppélia". Musik von Léo Delibes (1836-1891). Choreografie: Eduardo Lao. Mit Sophie Cassegrain (Coppélia), Yester Mullins (Doktor Coppelius), Cristian Oliveri (Franz) und dem Víctor Ullate Ballett. "Coppélia" ist eines der meistgespielten Ballette aller Zeiten. Delibes verband hier Musik und Tanz auf neue Weise. Daher wird er oft Vater der modernen Ballettmusik genannt. (Special, Music, Classical, Ballet) - 2016-06-30

classica.us.title: Septette von Mozart und Beethoven
classica.us.description: Die Solisten des Lucerne Festival Orchestra präsentieren zwei Septette in diesem Konzert, das 2020 im Kultur- und Kongresszentrum Luzern in der Schweiz aufgenommen wurde. Das Konzert beginnt mit Wolfgang Amadeus Mozarts Divertimento Nr. 11. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2023-06-24

classica.us.title: Werke von Bach, Bartók und Brahms
classica.us.description: Iván Fischer führt sein Budapest Festival Orchester mit Werken von Johann Sebastian Bach, Béla Bartók und Johannes Brahms. Die Aufführung wurde am 4. Dezember 2017 in der Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest aufgezeichnet. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2018-06-09

classica.us.title: Bach - Brandenburgisches Konzert Nr. 1
classica.us.description: J. S. Bachs Reihe der sechs Brandenburgischen Konzerte gehört zu seinen bekanntesten Werken. Zu ihrem 300-jährigen Jubiläum im Jahr 2021 spielten Václav Luks und das renommierte Barockensemble Collegium 1704 alle sechs Brandenburgischen Konzerte. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2023-06-04

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern. (Special, Event, Music) - 2022-05-31

classica.us.title: Chopin - 1. und 2. Klavierkonzert
classica.us.description: Antoni Wit dirigiert die Warschauer Philharmoniker in einer Konzertperformance von Frédéric Chopins Klavierkonzert Nr. 1, Op. 11, und Nr. 2, Op. 21 und eine Zugabe gibt es auch. Die Solisten sind die Pianisten Nikolai Demidenko und Evgeny Kissin. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2021-09-24

classica.us.title: Dvořák - Sinfonie Nr. 7, Op. 70
classica.us.description: Iván Fischer und das Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino spielen Werke von Mozart und Dvořák. Eröffnet wird das Programm mit Mozarts Sinfonie Nr. 34 in C-Dur. Im Anschluss wird Antonín Dvořáks Sinfonie Nr. 7 in d-Moll dargeboten. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2025-06-09

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Sinfonie Nr. 1 in C-Dur, op. 21
classica.us.description: Philippe Jordan dirigiert das Orchester de l'Opéra national de Paris in Beethovens Symphonie Nr. 1. Gespielt wird die Symphonie in C-Dur Op. 21, und diese zeigt die Loyalität Beethovens zu den Modellen von Joseph Haydn und Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2024-04-02

classica.us.title: Sinfonie Nr. 3, in D-Moll
classica.us.description: Gustav Mahlers Dritte Symphonie, komponiert zwischen 1895 und 1896, ist ein monumentales, programmatisches Werk, das Themen wie Natur, Menschheit und spirituelle Erhebung erforscht. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2026-02-14

classica.us.title: Faurés Requiem
classica.us.description: 2024 jährt sich der 100. Todestag von Gabriel Fauré, einem der herausragendsten und einflussreichsten Komponisten, der Lehrer von Maurice Ravel, Georges Enescu, Nadia Boulanger und vielen anderen war. (Special) - 2026-06-06

classica.us.title: In the Organ's Stomach
classica.us.description: Olivier Latry, der aktuelle Titularorganist der großen Orgel von Notre-Dame, führt die Zuschauer mit seinem Instrument auf eine Reise durch Landschaften, die Geschichte und unglaubliche Abenteuer, deren Zeuge das Instrument war. (Special, Music, Classical, Performing arts)

classica.us.title: Mahler, Symphonie Nr. 1 D-Dur
classica.us.description: Die Wiener Philharmoniker unter der Leitung von Leonard Bernstein spielen die Symphonie Nr. 1 D-Dur von Gustav Mahler (1860-1911). Diese Aufnahme entstand im Oktober 1974 im Wiener Konzerthaus. Als erster Dirigent nahm Leonard Bernstein alle Symphonien Gustav Mahlers nicht nur auf Schallplatte, sondern auch auf Video auf. Bernsteins Mahler-Zyklus ist ein einzigartiges musikalisches Dokument und trug zu einem neuen Verständnis von Mahlers Werk bei. (Special, Music) - 2012-12-06

classica.us.title: Mozart - Klaviersonate Nr. 5, KV 283
classica.us.description: Der Pianist Roberto Prosseda spielt die fünfte Klaviersonate von Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2021-09-03

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern. (Special, Event, Music) - 2022-05-31

classica.us.title: IVC 2021 - Finale: Schubert, Hahn, Ullmann u. a
classica.us.description: Matthias Hoffmann und Lisa Ochsendorf führen unter anderem "Il modo di prender morale" auf. Diese Aufführungen stammen aus dem Finale der International Vocal Competition 2021 - Lied Duo und wurden in 's-Hertogenbosch, Niederlande, aufgezeichnet. (Music, Classical) - 2023-09-12

classica.us.title: Chopin - Ballade Nr. 1, Op. 23
classica.us.description: Der Musiker Roberto Giordano interpretiert Chopins Ballade Nr. 1, Op. 23. Bereits aus 1831 stammen erste Entwürfe dieses Werks. Der Komponist hielt sich damals in Wien auf. Jedoch wurde die erste Ballade erst 1835 in Paris vollendet. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2020-06-12

classica.us.title: Gara Garayev: Herbstsonaten
classica.us.description: Pianist Vadim Repin und Bratschist Murad Hüseynov interpretieren Gara Garayevs Bratschensonate und 24 Präludien für Klavier. Aufgenommen in La Grange au Lac. Geschrieben und inszeniert von Juliette Swierczewski und aufgenommen in La Grange au Lac. Obwohl Garayev ein Komponist des 20. Jahrhunderts ist, trägt seine Musik Anklänge an die romantische Musik. Murad, der Hauptakteur, verkörpert eine jener von Einsamkeit geprägten Figuren, die in den romantischen Gemälden von Friedrich zu finden sind. (Family, Special, Music, Classical) - 2018-08-03

abcmelbourne.au.title: Midsomer Murders
abcmelbourne.au.description: S18 E6 Harvest Of Souls The daredevil riders of the Wall of Death roll into town for Whitcombe Mallet's annual harvest fair, and DCI Barnaby & DS Nelson must unravel a complex feud when the owner of an equestrian centre is trampled by his own horse.

abcmelbourne.au.title: Antiques Roadshow
abcmelbourne.au.description: S47 E2 Cromford Mills 1 The Roadshow visits Cromford Mills in Derbyshire where our experts dig up a garden gnome, a hundred year old bar of chocolate, and a Picasso.

abcmelbourne.au.title: Insiders
abcmelbourne.au.description: E36 David Speers and the panel discuss the week including interest rates rise to a 15-year high, inflation at 4%, fuel prices, cost of living, the economy, AI, digital safety and David Shoebridge becomes leader of the Greens.

abcmelbourne.au.title: News Breakfast ᴺᵉʷ
abcmelbourne.au.description: E198 Monday 5 October 2026 News Breakfast gives you the morning advantage. James Glenday and Emma Rebellato bring you the latest news, sport with Catherine Murphy and weather with Nate Byrne. Don't just start your day informed, start your day in front.

abcmelbourne.au.title: ABC News Mornings ᴺᵉʷ
abcmelbourne.au.description: E198 Monday 5 October 2026 Stay in the know with what's going on this morning. ABC News brings you up-to-the-minute news to fuel your daily conversations so you can stay connected and follow the discussion across the day. Presented by Kathryn Robinson.

abcmelbourne.au.title: Judgment: Cases That Changed Australia
abcmelbourne.au.description: S1 E4 Vote An unlikely hero takes on laws that silence citizens and reignites a democratic struggle older than the nation itself. (Final).

abcmelbourne.au.title: Father Brown
abcmelbourne.au.description: S12 E10 The Blessing of the Father Mrs Devine and Sullivan's wedding approaches, but can Father Brown stop a would-be killer from ruining their big day? (Final).

abcmelbourne.au.title: Stuff The British Stole
abcmelbourne.au.description: S1 E4 Shadow Boxer In a mystery binding together China, UK & Australia, British colonial forces took a golden warrior statue following an epic rebellion by Chinese martial artists. But how did it end up in a prestigious Australian building?

abcmelbourne.au.title: ABC News At Noon ᴺᵉʷ
abcmelbourne.au.description: E198 Monday 5 October 2026 The leading news at lunchtime. Ros Childs brings you the day's top stories and the latest news as it unfolds, with reporters in the community across Australia and around the world reporting on the issues that matter to you.

abcmelbourne.au.title: Landline
abcmelbourne.au.description: E34 Episode 34 A tasty sampler of stories from the land - covering food, agriculture, crops, climate, business and innovation - as we meet the fascinating people who make our rural and regional communities unique. Presented by Pip Courtney.

abcmelbourne.au.title: Back Roads
abcmelbourne.au.description: S4 E14 The Coorong, SA Heather Ewart visits The Coorong, an area spanning 130kms of South Australian coastline. It's a stunning mosaic of wild ocean beaches, lagoons and wetlands, but in many ways it's become the forgotten end of the Murray River.

abcmelbourne.au.title: Julia Zemiro's Home Delivery
abcmelbourne.au.description: S8 E7 Scott Farquhar Tech billionaire Scott Farquhar meets Julia at his childhood home in Castle Hill. Together they explore the places that helped transform an ordinary suburban kid into an innovative entrepreneur.

abcmelbourne.au.title: Murdoch Mysteries ᴺᵉʷ
abcmelbourne.au.description: S9 E8 Pipe Dreamzzz Murdoch and Ogden investigate the death of a student in an opium den.

abcmelbourne.au.title: Grand Designs Transformations
abcmelbourne.au.description: S2 E5 Booker Bay Studio and St Peters Extension In Adelaide, Cat wants to turn her 19th-century bluestone villa into a showcase for multi-generational living, and on the NSW Central Coast, Joe and Katherine want to transform their garden shed into a multi-purpose studio.

sbsbrisbane.au.description: Ernie travels to Ikara as known as Wilpena Pound in the spectacular Flinders Ranges and meets an Adnyamathanha Elder, a passionate cultural guide, a young pilot and a National Park's ranger.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Going Places With Ernie Dingo

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E4 Saffron It takes 150000 crocus flowers to make a kilo of saffron that costs $23000. The red gold has fascinated people since ancient Greece, Once disappeared, it was brought back in the Greek city of Kozani.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Yes, Chef!
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E6 Sweet Revenge The chefs are forced to come up with their best sweet dish to help temper the visitors who are coming back and looking for revenge, Martha and Jose are judging blind, the chefs in the cook-off.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: A Taste Of Island Dreams
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E1 Lemon Chilli Chicken With Turmeric Rice Learn to cook a signature dish at Island Dreams Cafe and an all-round family favourite. Alimah Bilda shares a version with a punchier, thicker sauce that coats the chicken and rice.
